text: Long Mande, ol saintis long Stanford University School of Medecine i tokaut olsem ol i bin wokim wanpela samting we i ken bungim ol wankain 'cells' wantaim: wanpela liklik 'chip' we i isi long printim na ol manmeri i ken wokim wantaim wanpela 'injet printer' na em bai yusim kain mani mak olsem wanpela 'US cent' long printim wanpela.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Ol lain i go pas long wok painimaut i tok olsem dispela i ken mekim ol kantri we i no gat planti mani long ditektim sik kensa, TB na malaria. Long dispela ol kantri mak bilong ol lain we i save winim ol sik kain olsem kensa bilong susu em i hap namba tasol bilong ol lain bilong kantri we i gat planti mani.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: JAS 39C Gripen i pundaun antap long rot bilong balus long eapot long 9:30 am long lokel taim (0230 UTC) na paia i kirap, na dispela i mekim na eapot i pas long ol balus bilong mekim moni long ron.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Pailet bilong dispela balus em i Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Lokel nius i tok olsem wanpela kar bilong kilim paia i tanim na kapsait taim em i go long kilim paia bilong dispela balus.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal i gat 28-pela krismas bin joinim Barça long tripela sisen (season) i go pinis, long Sevilla.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Taim em i muv i go long Catalan-kapitol, Vidal i bin pilai 49-pela gem long dispela klab (club).
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Dispela protes(protest) i stat long kain olsem 11:00 lokel taim (UTC +1) long Whitehall long oposit (opposite) bilong Dowing Street we polis i wok long banisim, dispela em i ples we haus bilong Prime Minister i save stap long en.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Bihain tasol long 11:00, ol lain bilong protes i pasim rot bilong kar long 'northbound carriage' long Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Long 11:20, ol polis i askim ol lain i mekim protes long surik i go bek long sait bilong rot, ol i tok olsem ol i nid long larim ol lain i protes bilong em i 'right' bilong ol na ol i nid long larim kar i go i kam long rot tu.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Long kain olsem 11:29, ol protes i muv i go antap long Whitehall, abrusim Trafalgar Square, bihainim Strand, abrusim Aldwych na i go antap long Kingsway na i go long ples we Conservative Party i wok long holim Spring Forum bilong ol insait long Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Rekod bilong Nadal taim em i resis wantaim wanpela pleiya bilong Canada em 7-2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Sampela taim i go pinis, em i lus taim em i pilai wantaim Raonic long Brisbane Open.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal i kisim 88% poin long gem na em i winim 76 poin long 'first serve'.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Bihain long dispela gem, King of Clay i tok, "Mi amamas long kam bek na i stap insait long fainal raun bilong ol impoten ektiviti. Mi laik winim dispela gem."
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: "Panama Papers" em i wanpela bikpela hap tok we i toktokk long kain olsem ten milien pepa bilong wanpela 'law firm' bilong Panama Mossack Fonseca, we sampela lain i givim i go long jenelis.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Ol dispela pepa i soim olsem fotinpela benk i helpim ol monimanmeri long haitim mani na kago long mak bilong bilien 'dollars' bai ol i no ken baim takis na bihainim ol narapela lo bilong mani.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Niuspepa bilong Britain The Guardian i ting olsem Deutsche Bank i kontrolim kain olsem 'a third' bilong 1200 'shell companies' we ol i bin yusim long mekim dispela.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: I bin i gat ol protes long olgeta hap bilong graun, sampela kot, na ol lida bilong ol gavman bilong Iceland na Pakistan i bin risain (resign).
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Ma em i bon long Hong Kong, na em i stadi long New York University na Havard Law School na em i bin holim wanpela "green card" bilong ol 'permanent resident' bilong America
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh i tok olsem long taim bilong ileksen olsem Ma bai i lusim kantri long taim bilong 'crises'.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh i tok moa olsem Ma is save laik long kisim foto na em i save long kainkain stail tasol em i no gutpela man.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Maski i gat ol dispela kain toktok, Ma i win long wanpela 'platform' taim em i toktok long America i mas gat gutpela rilesensip wantaim China.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Player of the Day bilong tude em Alex Ovechkin bilong Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Em i putim 2-pela gol na em i helpim ol narapela pleiya long putim 2-pela gol long gem we Washington bin winim ol Atlanta Trashers 5-3.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Namba wan taim we Ovechkin i bin helpim narapela long putum gol long dispela nait em long dispela gol bilong nupela pleiya Nicklas Backstorm we i winim gem;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: long namba tu gol bilong dispela nait we i bin namba 60 gol bilong em long dispela sisen (season), dispela i mekim em i kamap olsem namba wan pleiya long putim 60-pela o moa gol long wanpela sisen, bihain long Jaromir Jagr na Mario Lemieux tupela i bin mekim dispela long yia 1995-96.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten em i stap olsem namba 190 insait long list bilong 2008 400 Richest Americans na em i gat kain mani na kago mak olsem $2.3 bilien.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Em i greduet long College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia long 1950 na em i save givim bikpela mani long dispela institusen.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Ol i bin putim paia long wanpela kalabus bilong Iraq, Abu Gharaib taim dispela pait i bin kamap.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Dispela kalabus i kisim nem nogut long pasin bilong bagarapim ol kalabus manmeri taim ol US soldia i holimpasim dispela hap na ol i painimaut long dispela.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. i 'crash' long 2008 Singapore Grand Prix bihain tasol long em i mekim wanpela 'pit stop' long Fernando Alonso, na bringim sefti bilong kar i kam autsait.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Taim ol kar i stap fran long Alonso i go long kisim 'fuel' long aninit long 'safety car', em i muv i kam long fran na i win.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Ol i stopim Piquet Jr. long pilai gen bihain long 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Long 8:46 am stret, i no gat wanpela nois long olgeta hap bilong dispela siti, dispela em i makim taim we namba wan jet i bin 'crash' long 'target' bilong em.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Tupela lait em ol i putim bai lait bilong ol i sut i go antap long skai long nait.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Wok konstraken i wok long kamap long faivpela nupela 'skyscraper' long dispela hap, wantaim 'transportation center' na 'memorial park' long namel.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Dispela PBS progrem i winim moa long 24-pela Emmy award, na em i ron sotpela taim moa long Sesame Street na Mister Roger's Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Wan wan hap bilong dispela progrem i lukluk long wanpela bikpela topik insait long wanpela buk na bihain skelim dispela bikpela topik insait long planti stori.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Wan wan progrem i givim tu ol gutpela tingting long ol buk we ol pikinini i mas painim taim ol i go long laiberi.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, bilong WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow mama stesin) i tok "Reading Rainbow i lainim ol pikinini long wai ol i mas rit,... laik bilong ritim buk — [dispela progrem] i kirapim bel bilong ol pikinini long kisim wanpela buk na ritim."
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Sampela i ting olsem i no gat mani na ol tingting bilong yusim televisen long givim skul i senis olsem na dispela progrem i stop.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Bikpela win na ren, i kamap long mak olsem 645 'miles' (1040 km) west long ol ailan bilong Cape Verde, i luk olsem dispela bai i pinis bilong long em i go klostu long ol ailan na kamapim bagarap, ol 'forcaster' i tok.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Nau yet, spit bilong win bilong Fres em 105 'miles per hour' (165 km/h) na i wok long muv i go long 'northwest'.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred em i wanpela strongpela 'tropical cyclone' we i bin kamap long saut na is insait long Atlantic bihain long save bilong kisim 'satellite imagery' i bin kamap, na em i namba tri bikpela 'hurricane' we i stap long rekod bilong 'east of 35°W'.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Long Septemba 24, 1759, Arthur Guiness i sainim wanpela pepa we i tok olsem ol lain i ken rentim St James Brewery long Dublin, long Ireland, long 9,000 yia.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 yia bihain long dispela, Guiness i gro na kamap olsem wanpela intanesinol bisnis we i save kisim moa long 10 bilen euros (US$14.7 bilien) long olgeta yia.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, 'co-driver' bilong A1GP New Zealand tim, tude em i mekim nupela samting insait long histori bilong geim taim em i kamap olsem man we i draiv spit nogut tru antap long Auckland Habour Bridge, long New Zealand.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Mr. Reid i draivim dispela New Zealand A1GP kar, Black Beauty long spit we i winim 160km/h sevenpela taim antap long bris.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: New Zealand polis i painim sampela hevi taim ol i yusim ol 'speed radar guns' long lukim wanem mak bilong spit we Mr. Reid i wok long ron long en bikos long mak bilong longpela bilong Black Beauty, na wanpela taim tasol we polis i inap long kisim spit bilong Mr. Reid em long taim em i slo (slow) i go daun long 160km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Long 3-pela mun i go pinis, moa long 80-pela lain we ol i bin arestim (arrest) em ol i lusim ol i go fri long Central Booking senta na i no sasim ol.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Long mun Epril bilong dispela yia, wanpela sotpela 'restrainim order' em Judge Glynn i givim i go long dispela senta long mekim ol i mas larim ol lain we i bin holimpasim i stap long moa long 24-pela aua na i no kisim tok save long wanem taim bai ol i go long kot.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Dispela 'commisioner' i makim prais bilong 'bail', sapos em i givim, na em i mekim ol dispela sas we 'arresting officer' i tok long en i kamap olsem 'formal'. Ol dispela sas em ol bai i putim i go insait long komputa sistem bilong dispela 'state' na ol bai i gat rekod bilong dispela 'case'.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Na tu, dispela taim bilong kot i makim deit we inapim 'right' bilong saspek long go long kot hariap.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, dispela 'treasurer' bilong Australia em i man we i luk olsem em bai i kamap nupela Prime Minister bihain long John Howard olsem wanpela lida bilong Liberal pati i givim sapot olsem i mas i gat wanpela 'nuclear power industry' long Australia.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Mr. Costello i tok olsem taim 'nuclear power generation' i kamap isi long mekim, Australia i mas tingting long yusim em.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Sapos em i kamap olsem samting bilong salim na baim, yumi mas kisim em. Dispela em i min olsem, no gat man o meri i ken tok nogat long dispela tingting bilong kisim 'nuclear energy'" Mr Costello i tok.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Ansa i mekim ripot olsem, "polis i wok long tingting planti olsem ol i ken kilim sampela lida bilong ol mafia na dispela i ken kamapim bikpela woa insait long ol mafia long husat bai i kisim ples bilong dispela lida.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Polis i tok olsem Lo Piccolo i bin i gat gutpela sans long win bikos em i bin wok olsem man i save givim helpim long Provenzano long Palermo na bikpela ekspiriens bilong em i mekim na planti olpela ol bos i save rispektim em taim ol i wok long bihainim polisi bilong Provenzano long i stap isi tasol taim ol i wok long strongim 'power network' bilong ol.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Ol dispela bos em Provenzano i bin putim stopim ol taim em i putim stop long woa we i kamap bikos long Rinna i agensim gavman na dispela i mekim na tupela Mafia i dai, Giovanni Falcone na Paolo Borsellino long 1992."
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: CEO bilong Apple Steve Jobs i soim dispela nupela 'device' taim em i wokabaut i go antap long 'stage' na i kisim wanpela iPhone i kam autsait long poket bilong 'jeans' bilong em.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Insait long 2-pela aua we em i wok long toktok em i tok olsem "Tude Apple bai i mekim nupela samting i kamap long fon, Mipela bai mekim wanpela nupela samting long histori tude"
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brazil em i kantri we i gat bikpela lain manmeri bilong Roman Catholic long Earth i stap long em, na Roman Catholic Church i save tok nogat long man i maritim man na meri i maritim meri long dispela kantri.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Long 10-pela yia, National Congress of Brazil i bin tok pait long mekim dispela i kamap olsem samting we lo i tok orait long en, na dispela kain marit aninit long lo em i orait long Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Nambawan pepa lo em 'mayor' bilong São Paulo long bipo, Marta Suplicy i kamapim. Dispela pepa lo we ol i laik mekim em kamap olsem trupela lo, taim ol i skelim pinis, nau em i stap long han bilong Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Ol lain we i mekim protes i kisim wanpela 'petition' we i gat 1.2 milien siknesa long givim i go long National Congress long Novemba.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Taim samting i kamap ples klia olsem planti famili i wok long painim helpim i kam long lo long pait agensim 'eviction', ol i holim wanpela miting long Mas 30 long East Bay Community Law Centre long ol lain i bin painim hevi long 'housing scam'.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Taim ol lain i stap insait long ol dispela haus i tokaut long wanem samting i kamap long ol, planti bilong ol dispela famili i luksave olsem Carolyn Wilson bilong OHA i bin stilim ol 'security deposits', na em i ronawe long dispela ples.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Taim ol i harim olsem polis i wok long mekim investigesen long ol 'public housing property' long Oaklan,ol lain i save stap long ol haus long Lockwood Garden i bilip olsem i gat narapela 40-pela famili o moa bai i kisim 'eviction', long wanem ol i stap insait long dispela 'housing scam'.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Dispela band i kenselim (cancel) 'show' bilong ol we i bai kamap long Maui's War Memorial Stadium, we 9, 000 manmeri i laik kam long en, na ol i tok sori long ol lain i save laikim band bilong ol.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Kampani we i save menejim dispela band, HK Management Inc., i no tokaut long wanem as na ol i kenselim dispela 'show' long Septemba 20, tasol ol i tok olsem sampela samting i no bin kamap long taim.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Ol loya (lawyer) bilong Greece we planti lain i save long en, em Sakis Kechagioglou na George Nikolakopoulos, ol i kalabusim tupela long kalabus bilong Athens, nem bilong em Korydallus, long wanem ol i painimaut olsem ol i bin mekim 'graft' na 'corruption'.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Bikos long dispela, wanpela bikpela 'scandal' i kamap long komuniti bilong ol manmeri we i save mekim wok bilong lo na dispela i kamap ples klia taim ol i tokaut long ol kranki eksen bilong ol jas, loya (lawyer), solisita (solicitor) na ol atoni (attorney) we ol i bin mekim long planti yia i go pinis.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Sampela wik i go pinis, bihain long infomesen we wanpela jenelis Makis Triantafylopoulos i pablisim long Televisen 'show' bilong em "Zoungla" long Alpha TV, memba bilong Parliament na loya (lawyer), Petros Mantouvalos em ol i rausim em long ofis bikos em i stap insait long sampela 'illegal graft' na 'corruption'.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Na bikpela moa, nambawan jas Evangelos Kalousis em i stap long kalabus taim kot i painimaut olsem em i bin mekim 'corruption' na 'degenerate behaviour'.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts i tok stret olsem em i no laik tokaut long wanem taim em i bilip olsem laip i stat, dispela em i wanpela impoten kwesten we ol lain i save skelim taim ol i tok pait long pasin bilong kilim bebi em i orait o i no orait, na em i tok olsem em bai brukim lo bilong mekim wok sapos em i tokaut long ol wanwan liklik infomesen bilong dispela 'case'.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Tasol, em i bin tok, em i strongim gen toktok we em i bin mekim olsem Roe i salensim Wade em i bin "bihainim lo bilong graun", na em i tok strong olsem em i impoten olsem Supreme Court i mas mekim wankaim 'ruling' long olgeta taim.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Em i tokaut stret olsem em i bilip long 'right' bilong ol lain long infomesen bilong laip bilong ol i mas i stap hait na disisen bilong Roe bai i bihainim dispela.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore i bin pinis olsem namba wan, em i gat sikspela poin moa long Noosa husat i stap namba tu.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Dispela tupela sait i bin long bikpela 'semi final' we Noosa i winim dispela gem long 11-pela poin.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore i winim Caboolture long Preliminary Final.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae em i wanpela 'specie' bilong famili bilong Dromaeosauridae na em i kasin bilong Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Dispela em i gat gras bilong pisin long olgeta hap bilong bodi bilong em, dispela pisin i save kilim ol narapela animal na ol i ting olsem em i save wokabaut long tupela lek wankain olsem Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Namba tu lek bilong em i bikpela moa, dispela i mekim na em i gat dispela nem Hesperonychus we i min olsem "'western claw'."
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Narapela samting tu we i go wantaim bikpela ais, em ol weda we i strong tumas na i pasim rot bilong ol lain long go na helpim ol.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman i tok olsem ol dispela kodisen i inap long senis na kamap orait liklik i go inap long sampela taim long wik i kam.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Pitman i tok olsem, mak bilong bikpela bilong dispela ais, em i nogut tru long ol 'sealers' insait long 15-pela yia.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Nius i kamap long Red Lake komuniti tude olsem ol i arestim wanpela narapela sumatin we i stap insait long dispela 'school shooting' bilong Mas 21, dispela nius i kamap taim ol i wok long holim funerel (funeral) bilong Jeff Weise na narapela tripela bilong ol nainpela husat i bin i dai.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Ol atoriti i tok olsem ol i bin mekim wanpela arest long tude na ol i no mekim sampela narapela toktok moa.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Tasol, sampela lain we i gat save long dispela wok investigesen i tokim Minneapolis Star-Tribune niuspepa olsem em i Louis Jourdain, pikinini man bilong Siaman bilong Red Lake Tribal Floyd Jourdain.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Ol i no save yet wanem sas bai kot i makim o wanem samting i mekim na ol atoriti i go holimpasim dispela pikinini man, tasol wok bilong kotim ol pikinini i stat pinis long kot bilong gavman.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin i tok tu olsem ol ofisa i mekim disisen long kenselim (cancel) dispela 'runoff' long seivim ol lain long Afghanistan long spendim planti mani na bungim hevi long sait bilong sekuriti long narapela ileksen.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Ol 'diplomat' i tok olsem ol i bin painim planti samting we i no klia insait long mama lo bilong Afghanistan long mekim disisen olsem i no gat nid long wanpela 'runoff' long kamap.
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Dispela em i go agensim ol ripot we i bin kamap pastaim, we i bin tok olsem pasin bilong kenselim (cancel) 'runoff' em bai i no inap long bihainim mama lo bilong kantri.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: Dispela balus em i bin i go long Irkutsk na ol soldia we i stap insait long dispela hap i wok long operetim.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: Wanpela wok painimaut bai i kamap long investigetim dispela.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: II-76 em i bin wanpela bikpela komponen long soldia bilong Russia na bilong Soviet long yia 1970, na dispela i mekim na i gat bikpela eksiden i kamap long Russia long mun i go pinis.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Long Oktoba 7 wanpela enjin i lus taim ol i laik 'takeoff', na dispela i no kamapim bagarap long bodi bilong ol. Ol Russia i tok nogat long yusim 11-76 long sotpela taim bihain long dispela eksiden.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: 800-pela 'miles' bilong dispela Trans-Alaska Pipeline System em ol i bin pasim bihain long 'crude oil' i bin kapsait long tausenpela dram long hap saut bilong Fairbanks, long Alaska.
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Taim pawa i no wok gut bihain long wanpela 'fire-command test' we i save kamap olgeta taim, dispela i mekim na ol 'relief valve' i open na 'crude oil' i kapsait klostu long Fort Greely 'pump station' 9.
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Ol dispela 'valve' i open na i larim presa long kam autsait long sistem na oil i ron long wanpela 'pad' na i go long tenk we i ken holim 55, 000 dram (2.3 milien galen).
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Long Trinde avinun i kam inap nau, ol hol long tenk i wok long lik (leak) yet long dispela 'thermal expansion' insait long tenk.
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Narapela eria bilong putim ol samting we i stap aninit we i inap long holim 104, 500 dram em ol i no pulapim olgeta.
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Ol dispela toktok, we i kamap long televisen, em i namba wan taim we ol bikman long Iran i tok olsem 'sanction' i wok long mekim sampela senis i kamap.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Insait long dispela em sampela 'financial restriction' na wanpela tok tambu we European Union i putim long ol long salim 'crude oil' i go autsait long kantri, na ekonomi bilong Iran i save kisim 80% bilong mani we i kam autsait long kantri long dispela rot.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Long ol nupela ripot bilong em long olgeta mun, OPEC i tok olsem ol 'crude oil' we ol i salim i go autsait long kantri i go daun long level we i aninit tru long twentipela yia na nau em i stap long 2.8 milien dram long wanpela de.
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Nambawan lida bilong dispela, Ayatolla Ali Khamenei, i bin kolim dispela pasin bilong kisim mani long oil olsem "wanpela trap" we i stat long taim bipo long 'Islamic revolution' bilong Iran long 1979 na dispela em kantri i mas mekim em yet i kamap fri.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Taim dispela 'capsule' i kam long Earth na i kam insait long 'atmosphere', long kain olsem 5am ('eastern time'), em bai putim wanpela 'show' bilong lait long ol lain long Northern Carlifonia, Oregon, Nevada, na Utah.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Dispela 'capsule' bai luk olsem wanpela 'shooting star' i muv antap long skai.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Dispela 'capsule' bai i ron long kain olsem 12.8 km o 8 'miles' long wanpela sekon, spit bilong em i inap long stap long San Francisco na i go long Los Angeles insait long wanpela minit.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust bai i mekim wanpela nupela rekod long kamap olsem 'spacecraft' we spit bilong em i winim olgeta narapela long kam bek long Earth, na i brukim rekod ol i stap long May bilong 1969 long taim Apollo X 'command module' i kam bek.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: “Em bai muv i go long 'west coast' bilong hap not bilong Carlifonia na bai laiti skai bilong Carlifonia na i go long 'central' Oregon na i go long Nevada na Idaho na i go insait long Utah,” Tom Duxbury, projek meneja bilong Stardust i tok.
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Disisen bilong Mr. Rudd long sainim Kyoto climate accord bai i mekim United States tasol, we i kamap olsem wanpela divelop kantri we i no sainim dispela pepa.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: 'Conervative' gavman bilong Australia long bipo i bin no laik long sainim Kyoto, em i tok olsem dispela bai i bagarapim ekonomi bikos Australia i save salim 'coal' i go long ol narapela kantri, na ol kantri olsem India na China i no larim ol 'emissions targets' i stopim ol long sainim dispela pepa.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: Dispela em i bikpela samting tru we ol i baim insait long histori bilong eBay.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: Dispela kampani i laik long mekim profit bilong em i kam long kainkain rot na em i laik planti lain i save long em long ol ples we ol i save long Skype, kain olsem long China, Eastern Europe, na Brazil.
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Ol saintis i saspek olsem Enceladus em i 'geologically active' na em i wanpela samting we i ken mekim na Saturn i gat dispela 'icy E ring'.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Enceladus em i 'most reflective object' insait long 'solar system', na i save mekim rifleksen (reflection) long kamap long 90 pesen (percent) bilong lait bilong san we i pas long em.
text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: Dipela 'game publisher' Konami tok tude insait long wanpela niuspepa bilong Japan olsem ol bai i no inap long salim dispela geim (game) Six Days in Fallujah.
text_en: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Dispela geim (game) em ol i wokim bihainim stori bilong Battle of Fallujah, wanpela bikpela pait we i kamap namel long ol soldia bilong America na Iraq.
text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: ACMA i painimaut tu olsem maski dispela vidio i stap long intanet, Big Brother i no bin brukim ol lo bilong 'online content censorship' bikos ol i no putim dispela vidio long websait bilong Big Brother.
text_en: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: Broadcasting Service Act i save givim infomesen bilong kamap ol regulesen (regulation) bilong ol samting i save stap long intanet, tasol long wanpela samting long i stap olsem 'internet content', em i mas i stap long wanpela 'server'.
text_en: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: Embesi (embassy) bilong United States i stap long Nairobi, long Kenya i givim wanpela tok lukaut olsem "ol 'extremist' bilong Somalia" i wok long mekim wanpela plen long salim wanpela 'suicide bomb' long bagarapim Kenya na Ethiopia.
text_en: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: U.S i tok olsem em i kisim infomesen long sampela lain we i no laik long givim nem bilong ol na ol i bin tok olsem ol bai yusim ol 'suicide bomber' long bagarapim ol "impoten 'landmark'" insait long Ethiopia na Kenya.
text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Bipo long The Daily Show na The Colbert Report, Heck na Johnson i tingim wanpela pablikesen we i ken mekim fani long nius—na 'news reporting'—taim ol i stap olsem sumatin long UW long 1988.
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Taim em i stat i kam inap nau, The Onion i kamap olsem wanpela pablikesen bilong mekim fani long nius, wantaim wanpela niuspepa, wanpela websait we i kisim 5,000,000 kainkain visita insait long mun bilong Oktoba, ol 'personal ads', wanpela 24 aua nius, ol 'podcast', na wanpela soim wanpela 'world atlas' we ol i kolim olsem Our Dumb World.
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Al Gore na General Tommy Franks i stori long ol 'headlines' we ol i laikim tru (bilong Gore em taim The Onion i mekim ripot olsem em na Tipper i wok long amamas tru long sait bilong kuap bihain long em i bin lus long 2000 Electorial College).
text_en: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Planti bilong ol lain i save raitim ol stori bilong ol i go na i mekim bikpela senis long Jon ol 'show' bilong Jon Stewart na Stephan Colbert we i save mekim fani long nius.
text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: Dispela 'artistic event' em i pat bilong wanpela kempen (campaign) bilong Bucharest City Hall we i laik mekim piksa bilong kapitel bilong Romania olsem wanpela naispela siti we i gat planti gutpela samting long em.
text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: Dispela siti bai i kamap olsem namba wan sitilong 'southeastern' Europe long holim CowParade, bikpela bung bilong 'art' long olgeta hap bilong graun, namel long Jun na Ogas long dispela yia.
text_en: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: Tok save bilong tude i tokaut olsem em bai surikim promis we gavman i mekim long Mas bilong dispela yia long givim sampela moa 'carriages'.
text_en: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: Narapela 300 bai bringim totel (total) i go antap long 1,300 'carriages' we ol i mas kisim long daunim dispela pasin bilong bung bung tumas.
text_en: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: Chrstopher Garcia, wanpela mausman bilong Los Angeles Police Department, i tok olsem dispela saspela em i wanpela man na ol i wok long mekim investigesen (investigation) long em long sait bilong go insait long banis bilong narapela lain na i no long sait bilong bagarapim propeti (property).
text_en: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: Ol i no bin bagarapim dispela sain; ol i mekim senis long em wantaim wanpela blakpela kenves (tarpaulin) we ol i bilasim wantaim ol sain bilong bel isi na hat long senisim dispela "O" long kamap olsem liklik leta "e".
text_en: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: Retpela tait em wanpela 'marine organism' we i gat wanpela 'cell' na i save stap long graun i save kamapim, taim i gat planti moa bilong dispela 'organisim' we ol i kolim Karenia brevis.
text_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

text: Ol sampela samting long 'nature' i ken wok wantaim long kamapim ol gutpela kondisen, we i larim dispela 'algae' long kamap planti tru insait long sotpela taim tasol.
text_en: Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically.

text: Dispela 'algae' i save kamapim wanpela 'neurotoxin' we i ken mekim 'nerve' insait long ol manmeri na ol pis long i no wok.
text_en: The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish.

text: Planti taim, ol pis i save dai bikos i gat planti bilong ol dispela posin samting insait long ol wara.
text_en: Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters.

text: Ol manmeri i ken kisim bagarap long dispela taim ol i pulim win bilong dispela wara we win na sibruk i karim i kam.
text_en: Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

text: Taim dispela 'cyclone' i kamap strong nogut tru, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, nem bilong wanpela bek we ol wokim wantaim lip bilong 'palm' diwai long tok ples Maldives, em i kamapim win long mak bilong 240 kilomita long wanpela aua (149 'miles' long wanpela aua).
text_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) .

text: Long stat bilong tude, ol win i wok long blo long mak kain olsem 83 km/h, na i luk olsem strong bilong em bai i wok long go daun.
text_en: By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.

text: Long Trinde, National Basketball Association (NBA) bilong United States i stopim sisen (season) bilong em long pilai basketball bikos long COVID-19.
text_en: On Wednesday, the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) suspended its professional basketball season due to concerns regarding COVID-19.

text: Disisen bilong NBA i kamap bihain long Jazz pleiya (player) bilong Utah i kisim positif risalt (result) long test bilong em long COVID-19 vaires (virus).
text_en: The NBA's decision followed a Utah Jazz player testing positive for the COVID-19 virus.

text: Long infomesen i kam long dispela fosil (fossil), em i min olsem dispela 'split' i kamap bipo long taim we planti savemanmeri i tingim bikos long 'molecular evidence'.
text_en: "Based on this fossil, that means the split is much earlier than has been anticipated by the molecular evidence.

text: "Dispela em i min olsem ol i mas putim olgeta samting i go bek," man i go pas long risets long Rift Valley Research Service long Ethiopia na 'co-author' bilong dispela stadi, Berhane Asfaw i tok.
text_en: That means everything has to be put back," said researcher at the Rift Valley Research Service in Ethiopia and a co-author of the study, Berhane Asfaw.

text: Long bipo i kam inap nau, AOL i bin inap long muv na kamapim IM maket long laik bilong em yet, bikos planti manmeri insait long United States i save yusim.
text_en: Until now, AOL has been able to move and develop the IM market at its own pace, due to its widespread use within the United States.

text: Wantaim dispela plen we i stap nau, dispela fridom (freedom) i ken pinis.
text_en: With this arrangement in place, this freedom might end.

text: Taim yu bungim namba bilong ol lain i save yusim ol sevis bilong Yahoo! na Microsoft wantaim em bai kamap wankain olsem namba bilong ol kastoma bilong AOL.
text_en: The number of users of the Yahoo! and Microsoft services combined will rival the number of AOL's customers.

text: Northern Rock benk em ol i mekim i kamap olsem benk bilong kantri long 2008 taim ol i painimaut olsem dispela kampani i wok long kisim imejensi sapot i kam long UK Government.
text_en: The Northern Rock bank had been nationalised in 2008 following the revelation that the company had received emergency support from the UK Government.

text: Northern Rock i bin nidim sapot bikos em i bin stap insait long 'subprime mortage crisis' long 2007.
text_en: Northern Rock had required support due to its exposure during the subprime mortgage crisis in 2007.

text: Virgin Group bilong Sir Richard Branson i gat wanpela 'bid' long kisim dispela bek tasol ol i bin tok nogta long dispela bipo ol i mekim em i kamap olsem benk bilong kantri.
text_en: Sir Richard Branson's Virgin Group had a bid for the bank rejected prior to the bank’s nationalisation.

text: Long 2010, taim em i kamap olsem benk bilong kantri pinis, ol i rausim 'benk nogut', Northern Rock (Asset Management) long bikpela benk we i save mekim mani Northern Rock plc.
text_en: In 2010, while nationalised, the current high street bank Northern Rock plc was split from the ‘bad bank’, Northern Rock (Asset Management).

text: Virgin i bin baim dispela 'gutpela benk' long Northern Rock, i no 'asset management' kampani.
text_en: Virgin have only purchased the ‘good bank’ of Northern Rock, not the asset management company.

text: Ol i bilip olsem dispela em i namba faiv taim insait long histori we ol manmeri i lukim 'chemical' we i soim olsem tru tru i gat meteriel bilong ol 'martian' i pundaun i kamdaun long Earth.
text_en: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth.

text: Long kain olsem 24, 000 bilong 'meteorite' we i bin pundaun i kamdaun long Earth, 34-pela tasol bilong ol em ol i painimaut olsem tru tru ol i samting bilong Mars.
text_en: Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin.

text: Fiftinpela bilong ol dispela 'rock' em ol i tok olsem ol i kam long dispela 'meteorite shower' we i bin kamap long Julai bilong yia i go pinis.
text_en: Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July.

text: Sampela bilong ol dispela 'rock', we i no save stap long Earth, em ol i salim ol long m US$11,000 i go long $22,500 long wanpela 'ounce', na dispela prais em i tenpela taim moa long kost bilong gol.
text_en: Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.

text: Bihain long dispela resis, Keselowski i stap yet olsem lida bilong Driver's Championship wantaim 2,250 poin.
text_en: Following the race, Keselowski remains the Drivers' Championship leader with 2,250 points.

text: Long sevenpela poin bihain, em Johnson husat i stap namba tu wantaim 2,243.
text_en: Seven points behind, Johnson is second with 2,243.

text: Long namba tri ples, em Hamlin na em i stap twentipela poin bihain, tasol em i stap faivpela poin pas long Bowyer. Kahne na Truex, Jr. husat i stap namba faiv na namba siks wantaim 2,220 na 2,207 poin.
text_en: In third, Hamlin is twenty points behind, but five ahead of Bowyer. Kahne and Truex, Jr. are fifth and sixth respectively with 2,220 and 2,207 points.

text: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, na Harvick i stap insait long ol 'top-ten' posisen bilong Drivers' Championship na i gat foapela laspela resis i stap yet long dispela sisen (season).
text_en: Stewart, Gordon, Kenseth, and Harvick round out the top-ten positions for the Drivers' Championship with four races remaining in the season.

text: US Navy i tok tu olsem ol i wok long mekim investigesen long dispela hevi.
text_en: The US Navy also said they were investigating the incident.

text: Na tu, ol i tok insait long wanpela tok save bilong ol olsem, "'Crew' bilong dispela sip i wok long traim long painimaut wanem em i nambawan we bilong kisim dispela sip i kam autsait long rot we i seif"
text_en: They also said in a statement, "The crew is currently working to determine the best method of safely extracting the ship".

text: Wanpela 'Avenger class mine countermeasures ship', dispela sip i wok long go long Puerto Princesa long Palawan.
text_en: An Avenger class mine countermeasures ship, the ship was on its way to Puerto Princesa in Palawan.

text: Ol i bin givim em long Seventh Fleet bilong U.S Navy na em i save stap long Sasebo, Nagasaki long Japan.
text_en: It is assigned to the U.S. Navy’s Seventh Fleet and based in Sasebo, Nagasaki in Japan.

text: Chiao na Sharipov i givim ripot olsem ol i stap long wanpela ples we i seif long ol 'attitude adjustment thrusters'.
text_en: Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters.

text: 'Gound control' bilong Russia i ektivetim (activate) ol jet na dispela stesin i kisim bek 'normal attitude' bilong em.
text_en: Russian ground control activated the jets and normal attitude of the station was regained.

text: Dispela 'case' em ol i bin holim long Virginia biko em i ples bilong nambawan intanet 'service provider' AOL, dispela kampani we i putim dispela sas.
text_en: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text: Dispela em i nambwan taim we ol i yusim lo bilong 2003 long stopim 'bulk e-mail', narapela nem bilong em 'spam', we i kam long lain we i no kisim tok orait long salim dispela i go long 'mailbox' long kisim wanpela 'conviction'
text_en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text: Jesus i gat 21-pela krismas na i joinim Manchester City long yia i go pinis long January 2017 long klab bilong Brazil Palmeiras long wanpela moni mak £27 million.
text_en: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text: Long dispela taim i kam inap nau, dispela man bilong Brazil i pilai long 53-pela geim (game) long dispela klab long olgeta kompetisen (competition) na i skorim (score) 24-pela gol.
text_en: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text: Dr. Lee tu i tokaut long wari bilong em long ol ripot olsem ol pikinini long Turkey i kisim A(H5N1) 'avian influenza virus' na i no kamap sik.
text_en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: Sampela stadi i tok olsem dispela sik i mas lusim strong bilong em bipo long em i kamap olsem wanpela 'global pandemic', em i tok.
text_en: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: I gat wari olsem ol sikmanmeri i ken kontinu (continue) long givim dispela sik i go long moa manmeri taim ol i wokabaut raun sapos ol sain bilong dispela sik i no kamap ples klia.
text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Leslie Aun, wanpela mausman bilong Komen Foundation, i tok olsem dispela oganaisesen i kamapim anpela nupela lo we i no larim 'grants' o 'funding' long i go long ol oganaisesen we i stap aninit long investigesen bilong lo.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Polis bilong Komen i mekim na Planned Parenthood i no kwalifai (qualify) bikos em i gat investigesen i kamap long hau Planned Parenthood i save spendim na ripotim mani we Representative Cliff Stearns i wok long mekim.
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Stearns i wok long mekim investigesen long sekim sapos ol i wok long yusim ol takis long mekim ol 'abortion' insait long Planned Parenthood insait long wok bilong em olsem siaman bilong Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, we i kam aninit long House Energy na Commerce Committee.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Gavana bilong Massachusetts long bipo Mitt Romney i winim 'Florida Republican Party presidential primary election' long Tunde wantaim 46 pesen bilong ol vot (vote).
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: U.S. Speaker of the House bilong bipo Newt Gingrich i kam namba tu wantaim 32 pesen.
text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Bikos man i win i save kisim olgeta samting, Florid i givim fiftipela bilong ol ofisa bilong i go long Romney, na i pusim em i go kamao olsem 'front runner' bilong Republican Party nomination.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Ol lain i oganaisim dispela protes i tok olsem klostu 100, 000 mameri i go long ol siti bilong Germany kain olsem Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, na Hanover.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: Long Berlin, polis i kaunim olsem klostu 6,500 lain i mekim protes.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Ol protes i kamap long Paris tu, long Sofia long Bulgaria, long Vilnius long Lithuania, long Valetta long Malta, long Tallin long Estonia, na long Edinburgh na Glasgow long Scotland.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: Long London, klostu 200 manmeri i protes (protest) autsait long ol ofis bilong sampela bikpela 'copyright holders'.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Long mun i go pinis, i gat wanpela bikpela protes long Poland taim dispela kantri i sainim wanpela ACTA, dispela i mekim na gavman bilong Poland i mekim disisen olsem em bai i no inap long givim tok orait long dispela agrimen, long dispela taim.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Latvia na Slovakia i kisim longpela taim long joinim ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Animal Liberation na Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) i singaut gen long ol i mas putim ol CCTV kamera long olgeta 'abattoir' long Australia.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy i tokim ABC olsem pasin bilong mekim 'surveillance' na 'inspection' long ol 'abattoir' i mas kamap olgeta taim long Australia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: "CCTV bai givim wanpela strongpela toksave i go long ol lain we i save wok wantaim ol animal olsem pasin bilong mekim gut long animal em i wanpela bikpela samting tru."
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Intanesinel mep we i save soim guria i soim olsem i no gat guria long Iceland wanpela wik bipo long dispela. Dispela mep em i bilong United States Geological Survey.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Meteorological Office bilong Iceland tu i ripot olsem no gat ektiviti bilong guria long Hekla eria long 48 aua i go pinis.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Dispela bikpela ektiviti we i kamap long guria i mekim na 'phase change' i kamap long Mas 10 long 'northeast' sait bilong maus bilong volkeno.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Ol lain i lukim ol blakpela klaut we i no save kamap long taim bilong volkeno pairap long as bilong maunten.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Ol klaut long skai i mekim ol i paul sapos volkeno i bin pairap pinis, o nogat.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Luno i gat 120-160 'cubic metre' bilong 'fuel' i stap long em taim i stop long ron na ol strongpela win na sibruk i pusim em i go insait long 'breakwater'.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Helikopta i kisim twelvpela bilong ol memba bilog 'crew' na wanpela bagarap long bodi tasol em i wanpela nus i bruk.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Dispela 100-mita sip i wok long go long kisim 'fertiliser' kago we em i save kisim long olgeta taim na pastaim ol ofisa i pret olsem dispela sip i ken kapsaitim wanpela 'load'.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Dispela senis long lo em tupela haus wantaim i bin wanbel long em long 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Ol i bin mekim wanpela senis long dispela 'legislative session' taim House of Representatives i rausim namba tu sentens pastaim na bihain Senate i wanbel long dispela long Mande.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Dispela samting we i no stret long namba tu sentens, we i tok olsem ol i mas tok tambu long tupela man i marit o tupela meri i marit, na dispela i ken opim dua long ol dispela kain marit long kamap long bihaintaim.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Bihain long dispela proses (process), narapela 'legislature' we ol i makim long 2015 o 2016 bai i lukluk gen long HJR-3 long mekim em i stap insait long proses.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Ol samting we Vautier i mekim autsait long wok bilong 'directing' em i wanpela 'hunger strike' long 1973 agensim samting we em i lukim olsem 'political censorship'.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Lo bilong France i senis. 'Activism' bilong em i go bek long taim em i gat 15-pela krismas na i joinim French Resistance long World War II.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Em i stori long laip bilong em yet insait long wanpela buk bilong 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Long ol yia bilong 1960 em i go bek long Algeria we i kisim indipendens nupela yet long tisim 'film directing'.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Saveman bilong 'judo' Hitoshi Saito bilong Japan, husat i bin winim tupela gol medel (gold medal), em i dai taim em i gat 54 krismas.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: As bilong dai em ol i tok olsem kensa bilong 'intrahepatic bile duct'.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Em i dai long Osaka long Tunde.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Olsem wanpela man husat i bin pilai long Olympic na World champion, Saito i bin stap olsem siaman bilong All Japan Judo Federation treining komiti (training commitee) i go inap long taim em i dai.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Moa long 100 manmeri i kam long dispela pati, long amamasim namba wan eniveseri (anniversary) bilong wanpela man na meri we weding (wedding) bilong tuplea i kamap long yia i go pinis.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Ol i redim wanpela 'formal anniversary event' long kamap bihain, wanpela ofisa i tok.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Dispela man na meri i bin marit long Texas long wanpela yia i go pinis na i kam long Buffalo long amamas wantaim ol pren na famili.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Dispela man husat i gat 30-pela krismas, i bon long Buffalo, em i wanpela bilong ol foapela we i bin dai long dispela 'shooting', tasol meri bilong em i no kisim wanpela bagarap.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno em i wanpela tisa bilong English we planti lain i save long em na tu i no save wanbel long sampela wok bilong em we i bin tis aninit long Modern Education na King's Glory na em i bin tok olsem em i gat 9,000 sumatin taim wok bilong em kamap gut tru.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Long ol 'notes' bilong em we em i yusim sampela ol toktok we ol papamama i ting olsem ol i strong tumas, na ol i ripot olsem em i save yusim tok nogut insait long klas (class).
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education i sutim tok long em olsem em i no bin kisim tok orait na printim ol bikpela edvetismen (advertisement) long ol bas na em i bin giaman olsem em i 'chief English tutor'.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Na tu, ol i sutim tok long em long brukim lo bilong 'copyright infringement', tasol ol i no sasim em long dispela.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Wanpela sumatin bilong em long bipo i tok olsem em i yusim ol 'slang' insait long klas (class), em i tisim ol long pasin bilong 'date' insait long ol skul wok em i givim, na em i olsem wanpela pren bilong ol sumatin.
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Long tripela ten yia i go pinis, maski em i stap olsem wanpela 'communist state', China i kamapim wanpela 'market economy'.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Ol namba wan 'economic reform' i kamap aninit long lida Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Long dispela taim i kam inap nau, sais bilong 'economy' bilong China i gro 90-pela taim moa long mak we em i bin stap long en.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Long nambawan taim, long yia i go pinis China i salim moa kar winim Germany na i abrusim United States na nambawan bikpela maket bilong dispela indastri (industry).
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: GDP bilong China i ken kamap bikpela moa long Unites Sates insait long tupela ten yia.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Tropical Storm Danielle, we ol i kolim olsem namba foa 'storm' bilong 2010 Hurricane sisen (season), em i wok long redi long kirap long 'eastern' Atlantic Ocean.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Dispela bikpela win na ren, we i stap kain olsem 3,000 'mile' long Miami, Florida, i bin karim 'maximum' mak bilong win olsem 40 mph (64 kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Ol saintis long National Hurricane Center i tok olsem Danielle bai i kamap olsem wanpela 'hurricane' long Trinde.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Dispela bikpela win na ren i stap longwe long graun, dispela em i mekim na i hat long skelim wanem kain bagarap em i ken kamapim long United States o Caribbean.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek i bon long kapitel bilong Croatia, Zagreb, na planti lain i save long em taim em i pilai long Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Em i joinim ol long 1945 na i stap inap 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Long dispela taim em i stap wantaim dispela tim, em i skorim (score) 403-pela gol insait long 468-pela taim we em i pilai.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: No gat narapela lain i bin pilai long dispela namba bilong ol geim (game) o skorim (score) moa gol long dispela klab olsem Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Long 1995 ol i votim (vote) em olsem nambawan pleiya (player) insait long histori bilong Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Ol selebresen (celebration) i stat wantaim spesol 'show' bilong dispela grup Cirque du Soleil we olgeta lain long graun i save long en.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Bihain long dispela Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, wanpela Janissary band, na ol singa (singer) Fatih Erkoç na Müslüm Gürses i pefom (perform).
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Bihain Whirling Dervishes i go antap long steij (stage).
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Dispela singa (singer) Sezen Aksu i pefom (perform) wantaim 'tenor' bilong Italy Alessandro Safina na singa bilong Greece Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Long pinis, 'dance group' bilong Turkey Fire of Anatolia i mekim wanpela 'show' ol i kolim "Troy".
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, wanpela 'motocycle racer' wei gat 13-pela krismas, i bin dai bihain long em i stap insait long wanpela 'crash' long Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Taim em i stap long 'warm-up lap' bilong em, Lenz i pundaun long baik (bike) bilong em, na wanpela narapela 'racer' Xavier Zayat i bamim em.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Ol helt wokmanmeri i hariap long wok long em na ol i kisim em i go long wanpela lokel haus sik we em i stap long en na bihain em i dai.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat i no kisim wanpela bagarap insait long dispela eksiden.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Long sait bilong dispela hevi bilong fainens (finance) long graun, Zapatero i kontinu (continue) na i tok olsem "'financial system' em i wanpela pat bilong ekonomi (economy), wanpela impoten pat.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Mipela i gat wanpela longpela yia bilong 'financial crises', we nogut bilong em i kamap long tupela mun i go pinis, na mi ting olsem nau ol 'financial market' i wok long kamap orait gen."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Long wik i go pinis, Naked News i tokaut olsem em i bai i apim oda bilong em long mekim 'news reporting' insait ol intanesinol tok ples ', wantaim tripela nupela 'broadcast'.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Em i wok long mekim 'reporting' long English na Japanese, dispela 'global organization' i presentim ol progren long tok ples Spanish, Italian, na Korean, long televisen, long intanet, na long ol mobail divais (mobile device).
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Laki (lucky) na no gat samting i kamap long mi, tasol mi lukim wanpela samting we i mekim mi pret, taim ol manmeri i wok long traim long brukim windua na kam autsait.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Ol manmeri i wok long paitim ol glas wantaim ol sia, tasol ol windua i no inap long bruk.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Wanpela bilong ol glas i bruk, na ol i stat long kam autsait long windua," man we i bin stap insait long dispela hevi Franciszek Kowal i tok.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Ol sta i save givim lait na hot bikos long eneji (enegry) we i kamap taim ol 'hydrogen atom' i pas (o 'fuse') wantaim long kamap ol narapela 'element' we i hevi moa.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Ol saintis i wok long kamapim wanpela 'reactor' we i ken kamapim eneji (energy) long wankain we.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Dispela, em i wanpela hatpela problem tru long painim ansa bilong em na em bai i kisim planti yia bipo long mipela i ken lukim ol lain i bildim ol 'fusion reactor'.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Dispela 'steel needle' i trip anatp long wara bikos long 'surface tension'.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: 'Surface tension' i save kamap taim ol 'water molecule' long antap bilong wara i 'attract' long ol yet moa long ol i 'attract' i go long ol 'air molecules' i stap antap long ol.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Dispela ol 'water molecule' i mekim wanpela skin antap long wara we ai bilong yumi i no inap long lukim na ol i mekim ol kain ol samting olsem ol 'needle' long trip antap long wara.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Dispela 'blade' i satp long wanpela 'ice skate' bilong tude i gat 'double edge' na i gat wanpela hol i stap namellong dispela tuple 'edge'. Dispela tupela 'edge' i save mekim isi long 'blade' i holimpasim ais, maski taim em i tanim liklik.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Bikos aninit bilong dispela 'blade' em i 'curve' liklik, taim 'blade' i tanim liklik i go long wanpela sait, 'edge' bilong em i pas yet wantaim ais na i tanim.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Dispela i save mekim 'skater' i tanim. Sapos ol 'skate' i tanim i go long rait sait, 'skater' bai tanim i go long rait sait, na sapos ol 'skates' i tanim i go long lep sait, 'skater' bai tanim i go long lep sait.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Long go bek long level bilong eneji (energy) we ol i bin stap long en, ol i mas rausim ol narapela eneji we ol i kisim long lait.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ol bai mekim dispela taim ol salim wanpela liklik patikel (particle) bilong lait we ol i kolim olsem wanpela "photon".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Ol saintis i kolim dispela proses (process) olsem "'stimulated emission of radiation'" bikos lait i mekim ol 'atom' i senis na i kamapim 'emission' bilong wanpela 'photon' bilong lait, na lait em i wanpela kain 'radiation'.
