text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Dispela narapela piksa i soim ol 'atom' i rausim ol 'photon'. Na, trutru ol 'photon' i liklik moa long ol dispela i stap insait long piksa.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Ol 'photon' i liklik moa long ol samting we i mekim ol 'atom'!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Taim em i wok long planti handret aua, 'filament' insait long balb (bulb) i save kuk na lait balb i no save wok.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Yumi nid long senisim dispela lait balb (bulb). Em i impoten olsem yumi mas was gut taim yumi senisim lait balb.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Pastaim, 'switch' bilong dispela lait em yumi mas ofim o yumi mas diskonektim (disconnect) 'cable'.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Dispela em bikos ilektrisiti (electricity) i wok long ron i go insait long 'socket' we hap bilong balb (bulb) i gat metel (metal) long em i save sindaun na dispela i ken givim yu bikpela 'electric shock' sapos yu tasim insait bilong 'socket' o metel hap bilong balb taim em i pas liklik yet long 'socket'.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Dispela impoten hap bilong 'circulatory system' em i hat, we i save pamim blut.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Blut i save lusim hat long ol tiub (tube) ol i kolim ol 'artery' na ol i save kam bek long hat long ol tiub (tube) ol i kolim 'veins'. Ol liklik tiub tru em ol i kolim 'capillaries'.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Tit bilong wanpela 'triceratop' em bai inap long kaikai ol lip na ol stronpela han na rut (root) bilong diwai.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Sampela saintis i ting olsem ol Triceratop i bin kaikai ol 'cycad', wanpela kain plent (plant) we i save gro long planti hap long Cretaceous.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Ol dispela plent (plant) i luk olsem ol liklik pam (palm) diwai we i gat 'crown' we ol longpela sap lip i kamapim.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Wanpela Triceratopo i inap long yusim strongpela bik (beak) bilong em long rausim ol lip bipo long em i kaikai namel bilong dispela diwai.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Ol narapela saintis i tok pait olsem dispela ol plent (plant) ol i pulap long poisin olsem na ol dainaso i no inap long kaikaim ol, maski long tude, ol 'sloth' na ol narapela animal olsem ol 'parrot' (wanpela tumbuna bilong ol dainaso) i ken kaikai ol lip o frut we i gat poisin long en.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Wanem kain we bai 'gravity' bilong 'lo' i pulim mi? Sapos yu sanap antap long graun bilong 'lo', hevi bilong yu bai i liklik moa long hevi bilong yu long Earth.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Wanpela man we i hevi bilong em i 200 paun (90kg) long Earth em bai hevi bilong em i kamap olsem 36 paun (16kg) antap long 'lo'. Olsem na 'gravity', em nau, bai i pulim yu long mak we i liklik moa.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Sun i no gat wanpela 'crust' olsem Earth we yu ken sanap long em. Olgeta hap bilong Sun em ol ges (gas), paia, na 'plasma'.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Mak bilong ol ges (gas) i kamap liklik moa taim yu go longwe long namel bilong Sun.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Autsait hap we yumi save lukim taim yumi lukluk long Sun em ol i save kolim 'photosphere', dispela em i min olsem "bal we i lait".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Kain olsem tri tausen yia bihain, long 1610, wanpela 'astronomer' bilong Italu Galileo Galilei i yusim wanpela 'telescope' long lukim olsem Venus em i gat ol 'phase' bilong em, wankain olsem mun i gat.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Ol 'phase' i save kamap bikos dispela sait bilong Venus (o bilong Moon) we i tanim i kam long Sun em lait i save kisim. Dispela 'phase' bilong Venus em i sapotim tingting bilong Copernicus olsem ol plenet (planet) i save go raunim Sun.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Orait, bihain long sampela yia long 1639, wanpela 'astronomer' bilong England nem bilong em Jeremiah Harrocks i lukim wanpela samting ol i kolim 'transit of Venus'.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Taim ol i winim Danelaw long namba tu taim, no gat pait i kamap long England na ol i stap gut longpela taim.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Tasol long yia 991, Ethelred i bungim bikpela namba bilong ol Viking sip we i bikpela moa long olgeta narapela grup sip i bin i stap bihain long taim bilong Guthrum 100 yia i go pinis.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Dispela ol sip bilong pait em Olaf Trygvasson, wanpela man bilong Norway i go pas long ol. Olaf i laik kisim bek kantri bilong em long ol Danes, husat i wok long bosim i stap long dispela taim.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Bihain long ol samting i no kamap gut long ol soldia, Ethelred i wanbel long wanem ol samting Olaf i tok long en, na Olaf i go bek long Norway long traim na kisim bek kingdom bilong em. Em i winim sampela samting, tasol sampela samting i no kamap gut long em.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hanguel em i wanpela 'alphabet' we ol i wokim na planti lain i bin yusim long olgeta de. Dispela 'alphabet' em ol i bin kamapim long 1444 long taim King Sejong (1418 – 1450) i bin king.
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: King Sejong em i namba foa king bilong Joseon Dynasty na em i wanpela bilong ol king ol lain i save givim bikpela rispek long em.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Em i bin kolim Hangeul alphabet olsem Hunmin Jeongeum, dispela em i min olsem "ol stretpela saun bilong givim tok skul long ol manmeri".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: I gat planti tingting long wanem we Sanskrit i kamap. Wanpela bilong ol em i toktok long wanpela lain Aryan long hap wes i go insait long India na i karim dispela tok ples i go wantaim ol.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit em i wanpela tok ples bilong bipo na em i klostu wankain olsem tok ples Latin we ol i save yusim long Europe.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Olpela buk tru long olgeta hap bilong graun em ol i raitim long tok ples Sanskrit. Bihain long ol i raitim Upanishads, no gat lain i yusim Sanskrit moa bikos ol bikman we i gat pawa na atoriti tasol i bin yusim.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit em i wanpela tok ples we i narakain na i gat planti bikpela hap tok, we i bin stap olsem mama bilong ol narapela tok ples bilong tude long India, wankain olsem Latin em i mama bilong ol tok ples olsem French na Spanish.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Taim pait bilong France i pinis, Germany i stat long redi long kisim ailan bilong Britain.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Germany i givim 'code-name' long dispela pait olsem “Operation Sealion”. Planti bilong ol bikpela wepon (weapon) bilong British Army em ol i bin lus taim ol i lusim Dunkirk, olsem na ami bilong ol i no gat strong bilong pait.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Tasol Royal Navy bilong ol em i strong moa long German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) na ol i inap long bagarapim ol lain bilong pait we i kam long English Channel.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Tasol, wanwan bilong ol sip bilong Royal Navy i stap klostu long ol dispela rot bilong ol birua long kam bikos ol 'admiral' i pret olsem ol balus bilong Germany bai i bagarapim ol.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Yumi bai stat wantaim stori bilong plen bilong Italy. Italy em i stap olsem "liklik brata" bilong Germany na Japan.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Ami bilong em i no strong na navy bilong em i no strong, maski nau tasol i bildim foapela nupela sip bipo long woa i stat.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Namba wan as tingting bilong Italy em long kisim ol kantri long Africa. Long holimpasim ol dispela kantri, ol i mas i gat hap bilong salim ol man bilong pait, olsem na ol man bilong pait bai i sel long Mediterranean Sea na kisim Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Long mekim dispela, ol i mas rausim ol senta bilong ol sip bilong Britain we i stap long Egypt. Wantaim dispela, ol 'battleship' bilong Italy i no sapos long mekim narapela samting moa.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Nau long Japan. Japan em wanplela ailan kantri, wankain olsem Britain.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Ol 'Submarines' em ol sip we ol i disainim (design) long em i ken ron aninit long wara, na i stap long hap long longpela taim.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Ol lain i bin yusim ol 'submarine' long World War I na World War II. Long dispela taim ol i save ron isi isi tru na i no save sutim samting we i stap longwe long ol.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Long stat bilong woa ol i save ron klostu tru long antap bilong solwara, tasol taim ol lainim ol 'radar' bilong painim ol sip na balus na ol dispela 'radar' i wok long kamap gut, ol 'submarine i mas i go aninit long wara na ol bai i no inap long lukim ol.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Ol 'submarine' bilong German em ol i kolim ol U-Boats. Ol German i save gut tru long mekim 'navigation' na 'operation' long ol 'submarine' bilong ol.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Bikos ol i wok gut wantaim ol 'submarine', bihain long woa ol i no trastim ol German long i gat ol 'submarine'.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sampela taim ol i save kolim em olsem "King Tut" o "The Boy King", em i wanpela bilong ol king bilong Egypt long bipotaim we planti manmeri i save long em long tude.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Wanpela samting we i narakain em i olsem, ol lain bilong bipo i no ting olsem em i impoten tumas na ol i no putim nem bilong em insait long planti bilong ol list bilong ol king bilong bipotaim.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Tasol, ol i bin painim 'tomb' bilong em long 1922 na dispela i mekim na planti manmeri i save long em. Taim planti bilong ol 'tomb' bilong bipo em ol lain i bin i go insait long em na stilim ol samting, dispela 'tomb' em ol i no bin tasim.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Planti bilong ol samting we ol i putim wantaim Tutankhamun em ol i bin stap gut, wantaim tausim ol 'artefact' we ol i mekim long ol 'precious metals' na ol ston we i dia tumas.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Dispela 'spoke wheel' i mekim ol 'chariot' bilong Assyria i no gat hevi, i ron hariap moa, na i redi long winim ol soldia na ol narapela 'chariot'.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Ol spia bilong ol bunara bilong kilim man i ken go insait long klos pait bilong ol birua soldia. Long kain olsem 1000 B.C., ol Assyria i gat namba wan 'calvary'.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Wanpela 'calvary' em i wanpela ami we i save sindaun long hos na pait. Long dispela taim, ol i no bin wokim ol 'saddle' yet, olsem na ol Assyria i save sindaun antap nating long baksait bilong ol hos bilong ol taim ol i pait.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Yumi save long planti ol 'politician', saintis, na ol 'artist' bilong ol Greece. I luk olsem wanpela man bilong dispela kalsa we planti manmeri i save long en em i Homer, dispela 'poet' we i aipas, husat i kamapim tupela 'masterpieces' bilong 'Greek literature: dispela tupela 'poem' Iliad na Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles na Aristophanes em ol 'playwrites' we planti lain i save long en na ol drama bilong ol em ol save lain i save tok olsem ol i wanpela bilong ol nambawan wok insait long 'world literatue'.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Wanpela narapela man long Greek we planti lain i save long en em Pythagoras, planti lain i save long em bikos long 'theorem' bilong em long ol sait bilong ol 'right triangles'.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: I gat kainkain namba bilong ol lain i save toktok long Hindi. Ol i estimetim (estimate) olsem em i stap namel long namba tu na namba foa tok ples we planti manmeri long graun i save yusim.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Namba bilong ol 'native speaker' em i bihainim sapos ol i wankain ol i no wankain long ol 'dialect' we ol i wok long kaunim.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Ol i estimet (estimate) namba i stap namel long 340 milien i go long 500 milien manmeri we i save toktok long dispela tok ples, na kain olsem 800 milien manmeri i ken harim na save long dispela tok ples.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi na Urdu em ol i wankain long toktok tasol we ol i raitim em i narakain; long olgeta de, ol lain i save toktok long dispela tupela tok ples i save harim wanpela narapela.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Long kain taim olsem 15th century, long hap not bilong Estonia i bin stap aninit long Germany na i bihainim kalsa bilong em.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Sampela bilong ol bruder bilong ol Germany i laik bringim God i kam klostu long ol manmeri bilong dispela ples, olsem na ol i kamapim tok ples bilong Estonia na dispela tok ples i no gat tok piksa insait long en.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Dispela tok ples em i gat 'alphbet' bilong Germany na wanpela 'character' moa "Õ/õ" em ol i putim.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Bihain long sampela taim, planti wod we ol i kisim long tok ples i bung wantaim. Dispela em i stat bilong 'enlightenment'.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Long pasin bilong bipo, dispela man husat bai i kisim sia king i mas i go long 'military' bihain long em i pinisim skul.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Tasol, Charles i go long univesiti long Trinity College, long Cambridge we em i stadim Anthropology na Archaeology, na bihain History, na em i kisim 2:2 (wanpela 'lower second class degree).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles em i namba wan memba bilong British Royal Family long kisim wanpela 'degree' pepa.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace o Rumelia insait long Balkan peninsula) i kamapim 3% bilong dispela kantri.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Dispela teritori (territory) longpela bilong em i moa long 1,600 kilomita (1,000 mi) na bikpela bilong em i 800 km (500 mi), na seip (shape) bilong i klostu wankain olsem wanpela 'rectangle'.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: 'Area' bilong Turkey, wantaim ol raunwara, i karamapim 783,562 'square kilometres' (300,948 sq mi), insait long dispela 755,688 'square kilometres' (291,773 sq mi) i stap long 'south west' Asia na 23,764 'square kilometres' (9,174 sq mi) i stap long Europe.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: 'Area' bilong Turkey i mekim em i stap olsem namba 37 bikpela kantri, na sais bilong em i olsem sais bilong Metropolitan France na United Kingdom taim tupela i bung wantaim.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Ol solwara i raunim ol tripela sait bilong Turkey: Aegean Sea i stap long wes, Black Sea i stap long not na Mediterranean Sea i stap long saut.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg i gat longpela histori, tasol indipendens (independence) bilong em i stat long 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Ol sampelaa hap bilong Belgiun long tude i bin stap olsem hap bilong Luxembourg long bipo, tasol em i kamap ol hap bilong Belgium bihain long Belgian Revolution we i kamap long ol yia insait long 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg i save traim long stap olsem wanpela 'neutral' kantri, tasol Germany i bin holimpasim em na kisim em long World War I na World War II.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Long 1957 Luxembourge i kamap olsem wanpela memba we i kamapim dispela oganaisesen we tude yumi save long em olsem European Union.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong em i wanpela 'fortress' bilong bipo we i bagarap na i stap na em i wanpela Buddhist 'monastery' long hap antap bilong Paro District (long Phondey Village).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Ol i tok olsem long 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel i wokim wanpela 'fortress' long makim taim em i winim pait agensim ol soldia bilong Tibetan-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Long 1951, wanpela paia i mekim sampela ol 'relic' bilong Drukgyal Dzong tasol i stap, kain olsem piksa bilong Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Bihain long dispela paia, ol i lukautim na banisim dispela 'fortress', na em i stap olsem wanpela bilong ol narakain samting insait long Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Long '18 century' Cambodia i stap namel long tupela kantri i stap klostu long em we i gat pawa, dispela tupela kantri em Thailand na Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ol lain long Thailand i holimpasim na kisim Cambodia long moa long wanpela taim long '18 century' na long 1772 ol i bagarapim Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Long ol laspela yia bilong '18th century' ol Vietnam tu i holimpasim na kisim Cambodia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Etin pesen (percent) bilong ol Venezuela i no gat wok, na planti bilong ol lain i wok em ol wok insait long 'informal economy'.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: 'Two thirds' bilong ol Venezuela husat i wok em ol i save wok insait long 'services sector', klostu wanpela 'quater' i wok insait long indastri (industry) na wanpela 'fifth' i wok insait long 'agriculture'.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Wanpela impoten indastri (industry) bilong ol Venezuela em i oil, dispela kantri em i wanpela 'net exporter', maski wanpela pesen (percent) tasol i wok insait long oil indastri.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Stat long indipendens (independence) bilong dispela kantri, save bilong Singapore Botanic Garden i helpim long mekim dispela ailan i kamap olsem wanpela 'tropical' Garden City.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Long 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, wanpela 'orchid hybrid', em ol i bon makim olsem nesinel flawa bilong dispela kantri.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Long olgeta yia long kain taim olsem Oktoba klostu 1.5 milien animal we i save kaikai gras i save i go long ol 'southern plain', brukim Mara River, long ples ol i stap long en long ol 'northern hill' long go long ren.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Na bihain ol i go bek long hap not taim ol i go olsem long hap wes, wanpela taim gen ol i brukim wara Mara, bihain long ol ren i pundaun long kain taim olsem Epril.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Eria bilong Serengeti i gat Serengeti National Park, Ngorongoro Conservation Area na Maswa Game Reserve long Tanzania na Maasai Mara National Reserve long Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Pasin bilong lainim long kamapim 'interactive media' em i nidim 'conventional' na 'traditional' save bilong mekim wok, na tu ol tul (tool) bilong save long en insait long 'interactive class' em ('storyboarding', 'audio', na 'video editing', 'storytelling' na sampela moa.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Ol 'interactive design' i nidim yu long skelim bek gen ol tingting bilong yu long 'media production' na lainim long tingting long 'non-linear' we.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: 'Interactive design' em i nisim ol komponen (component) bilong wanpela projek long konek gut wantaim wanpela narapela, tasol ol i mas i gat mining taim ol i stap ol yet tu.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Ol samting we i no gutpela long ol 'zoom lenses' em i olsem 'focla complexity' na namba bilong 'lens elements' we ol i nidim long kisim wanpela 'range of focal lengths, em i ikpela moa long namba bilong 'prime lenses'.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Dispela em i no kamap olsem wanpela hevi moa bikos ol lain bilong wokim ol 'lens' i kamapim ol stendet we i antap moa insait long prodaksen (production) bilong ol.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Dispela i mekim ol 'zoom lenses' long kamapim ol piksa we i gat gutpela kwaliti we i wankain olsem piksa we ol i kisim wantaim ol 'lens' we i gat 'fixed focal length'.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Narapela samting we i no gutpel long ol 'zoom lenses' em 'maximum aperture' (spit) bilong 'lens' i save daunbilo moa.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Dispela i mekim ol 'zoom lens' we i no ekspesif (expensive) i hat long yusim ol long ol ples we i gat 'low-light' na i no wantaim 'flash'.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Wanpela bilong ol problem we i save kamap taim ol i traim long senisim wanpela vidio i go long DVD fomet (format) em 'overscan'.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Planti ol televisen em ol i wokim bilong mekim ol manmeri i amamas.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Long dispela as, olgeta samting yu save lukim long TV, sait sait bilong en, em ol i katim, long antap, daunbilo, na tupela sait.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Dispela ol i wokim bai piksa i ken karamapim olgeta hap bilong skrin (screen). Dispela em ol i save kolim 'overscan'.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Tasol, taim yu mekim wanpela DVD, bai yu katim ol sait sait bilong em tu, na sapos vidio i gat ol toktok we ol i raitim klostu tumas long daunbilo, ol dispela toktok bai i no inap long kamap.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Dispela kasol bilong bipo i bin kirapim tingting bilong planti manmeri. Em i bin mekim ol i tingim ol soldia i sindaun long hos na pilai, ol bikpela bung kaikai na ol pasin we ol lain long taim bilong King Authur i save bihainim.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Taim yu sanap namel long ol samting we i bagarap na i stap long taunsen yia i go pinis, yu ken tingim saun na smel bilong ol bikpela pait we i bin kamap long taim bipo. Yu ken pilim olsem yu inap harim lek bilong ol wel animal i ron antap long graun na tingim pret bilong ol lain i stap long kalabus.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Tasol yumi save tingim ol samting we i trutru, o nogat? Bilong wanem na ol i wokim ol kasol (castle), dispela bikpela haus bilong ol king na kwin long i stap long en? Ol i bin disainim ol na bildim ol long wanem kain we?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Em i pasin bilong planti lain long dispela taim, Kirby Muxloe Castle em i wanpela strongpela haus bilong hait na i no wanpela trupela kasol (castle).
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Ol bikpela glas windua na ol wol we i no bikpela ol i no inap long stopim ol lain i kam long pait.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Insait long ol yia bilong 1480, taim Lord Hastings i statim wok konstraksen (construction), dispela kantri i stap gut na ol i nid long banisim ol yet long ol lain bilong stil tasol.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Dispela balens bilong pawa em i bin wanpela sistem we ol kantri bilong Europe i bin laikim long mekim olgeta steit (state) bilong Europe i kontinu (continue) long holim yet wanwan pawa bilong ol.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Dispela tingting em i olsem olgeta kantri bilong Europe i mas traim long stopim wanpela kantri long i gat moa pawa long ol narapela, olsem na ol nesinel gavman i save senisim ol lain we ol i ken wok bung wantaim long mekim na dispela balens i mas i stap.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: War of Spanish Succession em i makim namba wan woa we as tingting bilong en em long mekim na balens bilong pawa i mas stap.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Dispela em i makim wanpela impoten senis, bikos ol kantri bilong Europe i no inap moa long pait bikos long lotu. Olsem na, dispela Thirty Years' War em bai i stap olsem laspela woa we ol i kolim olsem 'religious war'.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Tempel bilong Artemis long Ephesus em ol i bin bagarapim long Julai 21, 356 BCE taim Herostratus. i putim paia long em.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Stori i tok olsem, as tingting bilong em i olsem em i laik kisim biknem. Ol lain bilong Ephesia, ol i belhat nogut tru, ol i tok olsem bai i nogat rekod bilong nem bilong Herostratus.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Bihain Strabo wanpela 'historian' bilong Greece i raitim nem bilong em, na tude yumi save long en. Tempel em ol i bin bagarapim long seim (same) nait we Alexander the Great i bin bon.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, taim em i king, i tok long baim ol lain long bildim gen dispela tempel, tasol ol i no larim em. Bihain, taim Alexander i dai pinis, ol i bildim gen dispela tempel long 323 BCE.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Yu mas sekim na lukim olsem han bilong yu em i stap isi taim yu pilai ol dispela 'note' stret - na tu traim long no muvim nating pinga bilong yu.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Long dispela we, yu bai no inap mekim yu yet i pilim tait tumas. Tingim olsem i no gat nid long paitim ol ki wantaim bikpela strong long mekim volum (volume) i go antap kain olsem long piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Long 'accordion', long kisim moa volum (volume), yu yusim ol 'bellow' wantaim moa presa (pressure) o spit.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: 'Mysticism' em i wanpela rot bilong stap wantaim 'ultimate reality', 'divinity', 'spiritual truth', o God.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Dispela man o meri we i bilip i laik i gat ekspiriens o save long 'divine realiy'/god o ol god.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Ol lain we i save bihainim wanpela bilip i save bihainim wanpela kain we bilong stap, o mekim ol samting we bai mekim ol dispela ekspiriens i kamap gutpela moa.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: 'Mysticism' em i narakain long ol narapela kain bilip na pasin bilong lotu bikos em i toktok moa long pasin bilong i gat wampela ekspirens wantaim 'unique state of conciousness', bikpela moa long sait bilong i stap bel isi, i gat gutpela tingting, i stap amamas.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhism em i wanpela lotu bilong India. Em i stat long Punjap rijen long '15th century' taim wanpela bruk i kamap insait long tredisen (tradition) bilong ol Hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Ol Sikh i save lukim bilip bilong ol olsem em i wanpela narapela lotu long Hinduism, maski ol i tokaut olsem em i kam long Hindu na sampela ol tredisen (tradition) bilong em i olsem bilong ol Hindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Ol Sikh i save kolim lotu bilong ol olsem Gurmat, long tok ples Punjabi dispela em i min olsem "pasin bilong 'guru'". 'Guru' em i wanpela bikpela samting insait long olgeta ol lotu bilong India, tasol insait long Sikhism 'guru' em impoten long wanem em i kamapim ol nambawan samting insait long bilip bilong ol Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Guru Nanak (1469–1539) i kamapim dispela lotu long '15 century'. Bihain long em i gat nainpela 'guru' moa i bin kamap.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Tasol, long June 1956, ol protes (protest) we i kamap long Poland i testim ol promis bilong Krushchev, we ol wokmanmeri i protes long kaikaini save sot na ol i katim pwl bilong ol, na dispela i tanim na kamap olsem wanpela protes long Communism.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Mekim i go na, Krushchev i salim ol 'tank' long kamapim oda, em i tok orait long sampela askim bilong ol long sait bilong mani na i wanbel long makim Wladyslaw Gomulka we planti man i laikim long kamap olsem nupela praim minista.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Indus Vally Civilization em i wanpela 'civilization' we i kamap long taim bilong Bronz Age long 'northwest' hap bilong India na i karamapim bikpela hap bilong Pakistan long tude na sampela rijen insait long 'northest' India na 'northeast' Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Dispela 'civilisation' i stap long ol arere bilong Indus River we em i kisim nem bilong em long en.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Maski sampela saveman i ting olsem bikos dispela 'civilization' i stap tu long arere bilong Saravati River we i drai pinis, ol i mas kolim dispela 'civilization' olsem Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, sampela i kolim em olsem Harappan Civilization bihainim Harappa, dispela em i nem bilong namba wan hap we ol i bin eksevetim (excavate) long ol yia insait long 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Roman empire i gat bikpela militeri (miltary) na dispela i mekim save bilong ol long marasin na bodi i kamap bikpela moa.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Emperor Augustus i kisim ol dokta long wok insait long dispela na em i kamapim tu namba wan Roman Medical Corps bilong yusim bihain long taim bilong pait.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Ol 'surgeon' i gat save bilong ol kainkain marasin bilong mekim ol man i slip na ol i save long 'morphine' we ol i save kisim long ol 'poppy seed' na ol 'scopolamine' we ol i save kisim long ol 'herbane seed'.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Ol i save gut tru long katim hap lek o hap han bilong ol man long seivim (save) ol bai ol i no ken kisim 'gangrene' na ol i save tu long 'tourniquet' na 'arterial clamps' we i save stopim blut long ron.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Long planti 'century', Roman emppire i go pas long planti bikpela samting long sait bilong marasin na kamapim planti infomesen we yumi save long en tude.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland origami em i 'origami' we i gat tambu long en na yu ken mekim wanpela fold long wanpela taim, ol hatpela fold kain olsem 'reverse fold' em i tambu, na olgeta fold i gat stretpela ples bilong em.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Dispela em John Smith i bin kamapim long 1970s long helpim ol lain we i no save long foldim pepa o lain i no inap long muvim ol pinga bilong ol.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Ol pikinini i save luksave long wanem samting em 'race' na ol 'racial stereotype' taim ol i liklik yet na ol dispela 'racial stereotype' i save mekim em i gat wanpela kain tingting na pasin.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Wanpela eksampel em i olsem, ol pikinini we i pilim olsem ol i kam long wanpela 'race' we ol i save tok olsem ol i no save skul gut bai i no inap long mekim gut ol skul wok bilong ol taim ol i painimaut olsem ol lain i save ting olsem long 'race' bilong ol.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace em i namba tri namel long ol websait we planti manmeri long United States i save long en na nau yet em i gat 54 milien profail (profile).
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Long sait bilong edukesen, planti lain i bin toktok long dispela websait.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: I gat ol gutpela sait bilong ol dispela websait, dispela em ol kain samting olsem, isi long wokim wanpela klas pes we i gat ol blog, vidio, foto na ol narapela samting.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Dispela pes bilong websait em i isi long i go long en bikos em i gat wanpela web edres, we i mekim bai ol manmeri i ken tingim na em i isi long ol sumatin husat i save painim hat long yusim kibod o i save painim hat long speling.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Yu ken mekim senis long em long mekim em i kamap isi long rit na i gat planti kala o liklik kala bihainim laik bilong yu.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Attention Deficit Disorder "em i wanpela 'neurological syndrome' na ol nambawan sain em 'impulsivity', 'distractibility', na 'hyperactivity' o 'excess energy'".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Em i no wanpela 'learning disability', em i wanpela 'learning disorder', em i save "kamap long 3 i go long 5 pesen (percent) bilong olgeta pikinini, ating kain olsem 2 milien pikinini long America".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Ol pikinini we i gat ADD i save painim hat long 'focus' long ol samting olsem skul wok, tasol ol i ken konsentret (concerntrate) long ol samting we ol i save amamas long mekim kain olsem pilai ol geim (game) o lukim katun (cartoon) we ol i save laikim o raitim ol sentens we i no gat 'punctuation'.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Ol dispela pikinini i save laik long i stap insait long planti trabel, bikos ol i save "mekim ol 'risky behavior', stap insait long ol pait, salensim atoriti" long kirapim brein (brain) bilong ol, bikos ol nomol samting i no save kirapim brein bilong ol.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD i save mekim senis i kamap long ol rilesensip we ol i gat wantaim ol narapela pikinini bikos ol i no inap long klia gut long wanem as na ol i save ekt olsem o bilong wanem na ol i spelim ol wod long dispela kain we o level bilong 'maturity' bilong ol em i narapela.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Taim dispela pasin bilong kisim save na lainim samting em i senis long dispela kain we mipela i tok long en 'base rate' we yumi save kisim save em tu i senis.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Rot bilong kisim infomesen em i narapela kain. Dispela presa (pressure) bilong tingim bek samting em i no stap long wanpela man long tingim bek, tasol em i stap long ol lain husat i inap long tingim wanem samting ol i raitim long pepa.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Bikpela tru, Renaissance i mekim wanpela bikpela senis long pasin bilong lainim samting na givim save.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: I no olsem ol narapela 'primates', ol 'hominid' i no yusim han bilong ol long muv o karim hevi o swing namel long ol diwai.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Ol han na lek bilong ol 'chimpanzee' ol i wankain long sais na longpela bilong ol, dispela i soim olsem ol i yusim han bilong ol long karim hevi bilong bodi bilong ol taim ol i wokabaut long han.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Han bilong ol man em i sot moa long lek bilong ol, na ol i gat ol 'phalange' we i stret moa.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Ol fosil (fossil) bilong bun bilong han we i bilong tu milien o tri milien yia i go pinis i soim olsem i gat senis i kamap long wok bilong han we ol i bin yusim long muv na nau ol i yusim long mekim ol samting.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Sampela manmeri i bilip olsem taim yu lukim planti driman we i no tru long planti taim dispela i ken mekim yu i pilim tait nogut tru.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Nambawan as na dispela samting i kamap em i risalt (result) bilong ol klia driman we i isi long tingim. Dispela i mekim taim namel long REM i go longpela.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Taim i no gat inap REM long wanpela nait, dispela em mak we bodi bilong yu i save slip na bodi bilong yu i no malolo gut na dispela em bai kamap wanpela problem.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Dispela em bai mekim yu i pilim tait tru wankain olsem sapos yu kirap long olgeta twenti o teti minit na lukim TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Dispela 'effect' em i bihainim hamaspela taim brein (brain) bilong yu i traim long i gat klia driman long wanpela nait.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Ol samting i no go gut long ol Italy long North Africa. Dispela i kamap long namba wan taim ol i go kamap long hap. Italy i bin tokaut olsem em bai i go insait long bikpela pait long Jun 10, 1940, orait long dispela wik yet, ol British 11th Hussars i holimpasim na kisim Fort Capuzzo long Libya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Long hap i go long ist bilong ples Bardia, ol Britain i hait i stap na i holimpasim General Lastucci, Nambawan Enjinia bilong Tenth Army bilong ol Italy.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Long Jun 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, Governor-General bilong Libya i bin dai taim em i go long Tobruk. Em i inap long kisim ples bilong Mussolini, tasol ol lain bilong em yet i abrus na i kilim em.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Wanpela 'sport' bilong tude ol i kolim 'fencing' em ol i save pilai long planti level, stat long ol sumatin long univesiti (university) na i go long Olympic kompetisien (competition).
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Dispela 'sport' em ol i save pilai tupela tupela, wanpela 'fencer' i save pilai agensim narapela 'fencer'.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golf em i wanpela geim (game) we tupela pleiya (player) i save yusim ol 'club' long paitim ol bal i go insait long ol hol.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: ol i save pilai long etinpela hol long wanpela 'regualr round', we ol plaiya (player) i stat long namba wan hol bilong 'course' na pinis long namba etin hol.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Dispela pleiya (player) husat i yusim liklik namba bilong ol 'strokes', o 'swings' long 'club' bilong em insait long dispela 'course' em i save win.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Dispela geim (game) em ol i save pilai long gras, na ol i gras ww i raunim hol em ol i save katim em i go got moa na ol i save kolim em olsem 'green'.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Ating wanpela bilong ol 'tourism' we planti lain i save long en em pasin bilong raun i go long narapela ples: 'Recreation tourisim'.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Dispela em i taim we ol manmeri i go long wanpela ples wei narakain long ples we ol i stap long en na ol i save lukluk raun na amamas.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Ol nambis, ol 'theme park' na ol 'camp ground' em ol ples we planti ol 'recreation tourist' i save go long en.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Sapos as tingting bilong wanpela man o meri long i go long wanpela ples long save long histori na kalsa orait dispela kain 'tourism' em ol save kolim olsem 'cultural tourism'.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Ol turis i ken go lukim ol kainkain 'landmark' bilong wanpela kantri o ol i ken lukluk long wanpela eria tasol.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Ol Colonist, taim ol i lukim dispela samting, ol tu i salim tok long sampela moa soldia long kam.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Ol soldia we i kam long strongim ol 'forward position' em ol 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments we i gat 200 man, we i wok aninit long Colonels John Stark na James Reed (bihain tupela wantaim i kamap olsem ol jenerel.
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Ol man i wok aninit long Stark i kisim ol posisen long sait bilong banis i stap long hap not long posisen bilong ol Colonist.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Taim drai wara i opim wanpela spes long Mystic River long 'northeast' bilong dispela 'peninsula', hariap tru ol i surikim banis we ol i wokim wantaim wanpela sotpela ston wol i go long hap not na i stop long arere bilong wara long wanpela liklik nambis.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley o Stark i putim wanpela pos we i kain olsem 100 'feet' (30 m) long fran bilong banis na tok olsem no gat wanpela i mas sut long gan inap ol 'regular' i kam i go.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Plen bilong America em long kirapim pait we ol i plenim pinis long tripela sait.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: General John Cadwalder bai statim wanpela 'diversionary attack' long ol British soldia long Bordentown, long pasim rot bilong ol nupela soldia long kam na joinim ol British soldia.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: General James Ewing bai kisim 700 lain bilong pait na brukim wara long Trenton Ferry, na holimpasim bris i stap antap long Assunpink Creek na banisim ol soldia bilong birua long ranawe.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Na ol nambawan lain bilong pait em 2,400 man na ol bai brukim wara long ples we i nainpela 'mile' not long Trenton, na ol bai bruk i go long tupela grup, wanpela bai i stap aninit long Greene na narapela bai i stap aninit long Sullivan, long statim pait bipo long san i kirap.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ol i save senis long 'quarter' i go long 'half mile run', long dispela taim spit em i no impoten na pasin bilong stap strong na go het yet em i impoten.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Em i tru olsem wanpela 'first-class half-miler', wanpela man husat i ken ran long dispela mak insait long tupela minit, em i mas i gat bikpela spit, tasol pasin bilong stap strong na go het yet em yumi mas lainim bilong helpim yumi long olgeta kain hevi.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Sampela kantri 'cross running' long winta (winter), em ol i bungim wantaim 'gymnasium work' bilong antap bilong bodi, dispela em i nambawan rot bilong redi long 'running season'.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Gutpela kaikai tasol i no inap long mekim ol gutpela pefomens (performance) i kamap, tasol em i ken mekim yanpela 'athlete' i stap gut.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Stap long wanpela helti eneji balens, prektisim pasin bilong dring wara, ol save long ol kainkain rot we ol narapela prektis i ken helpim 'athlete' i ken mekim pefomens (performance) bilong ol i kamap gut na mekim ol i amamas long pilai dispela 'sport'.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: 'Middle distance running' em i wanpela 'sport' we i no yusim planti mani; tasol, i gat ol kainkain rong tingting long ol sampela ikwipmen (equipment) we ol lain i mas i gat long stap insait long dispela 'sport'.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Ol i ken baim ol dispela prodak sapos ol i nidim, tasol planti bai i gat liklik o no gat senis i kamap long pefomens (performance).
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Ol 'athlete' i ken pilim olsem ol i laikim wanpela prodak taim em i no givim gutpela samting.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Ol 'atom' em ol wanpela bilong ol nambawan samting we i kamapim olgeta 'matter'.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Em i wanpela narapela kain 'entity', we liklik model bilong Bohr i tok, em i gat wanpela 'central nucleus' we ol 'electron' i save raunim, wankain olsem ol plenet (planet) i save raunim san-lukim Piksa 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Ol 'nucleus' i gat tupela 'particle'- 'neutrons' na 'protons'.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Ol 'proton' i gat 'positive electric charge' na ol 'neutron' i no gat 'charge'. Ol 'electron' i gat wanpela 'negative electric charge'.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Long sekim dispela man o meri i stap long hevi, pastaim yu mas mekim sevei long ples we hevi i kamap long lukim olsem yu i stap seif.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Yu nid long luksave long posisen bilong man o meri we i stap long hevi taim yu wok long i go long em na luksave tu long ol samting we i no stret.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Sapos yu kisim bagarap taim yu traim long helpim, yu bai mekim ol samting i kamap nogut moa.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Dispela stadi i painimaut olsem 'depression', pret na 'catastrophising' i gat rilesensip namel long pen na 'disability' long ol lain i gat pen long daunbilo long baksait bilong ol.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Insait long ol 'structured PA session' we i wok long kamap long olgeta wik, ol i lukim olsem dispela senis i kamap bikos long 'catastrophizing', na i no long 'depression' na pasin bilong pret.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Ol lain we i stap insait long ol dispela ektiviti i nidim moa sapot long wanem we ol i lukim pain na save long wanem em i 'chronic pain' na wanem em i 'discomfort' tasol we i kamap long nomol muvmen bilong bodi.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: 'Vision', o inap long lukim ol samting em i kamap bikos long 'visual system sensory organs' o ol ai.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: I gat ol planti kainkain konstraksen bilong ol ai, we i bihainim wanwan samting i stap insait long wanpela animal o bihainim wanem samting dispela animal i nidim.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Ol dispela kainkain konstraksen (construction) i gat kainkain samting ol i ken mekim, sampela em ol i ken save long ol kainkain 'wave-length' na ol i gat ol kainkain level bilong strong bilong ol, na tu ol i nidim ol kainkain proses (process) long mekim mining long ol samting i kam insait long ai na ol i nidim ol kainkain namba bilong samting long wok gut.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Wanpela populesen (population) em wanpela grup bilong wanpela 'specie' we i stap insait long wanpela eria.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Taim olgeta wanwan insait long wanpela populesen (population) i gat wankain 'phenotypic trait' ol i save kolim ol olsem 'monomorphic'.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Taim wanwan bilong ol i soim sampela 'variant' bilong wanpela 'trait' ol i save kolim olsem 'polymorphic'.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Ol 'army colony' bilong ol anis tu i save mas na mekim haus long ol kainkain 'phase'.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Insait long 'nomadic phase', ol 'army' anis i save mas long nait na stop long kem long de.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: 'Colony' i save statim wanpela 'nomadic phase' taim kaikai i go daun. Long dispela 'phase', 'colony' i save mekim ol haus bilong sotpela taim we ol i save senisim long olgeta de.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Wanwan bilong ol dispela pasin bilong raun o mas long wanpela ples i go long narapela em i save stap inap long kain olsem 17-pela de.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Wanem samting i stap insait long wanpela 'cell'? Dispela wod 'cell' em i kam long Latin wod "'cella'", mining bilong en em "liklik rum", na man we i kamapim dispela wod em i wanpela 'microscopist' we i wok long stadim straksa (structure) bilong 'cork'.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: 'Cell' em i wanpela liklik samting we i karim laip na i stap insait long olgeta samting i gat laip, na olgeta samting i gat laip em ol i gat wanpela o moa long wanpela 'cell'.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Ol 'cell' em ol nambawan samting tru na ol i impoten long stadi bilong laip, em i tru olsem, planti taim ol lain i save kolim ol olsem "ol samting we i bildim laip".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Nervous System i save mentenim 'homeostasis' taim em i salim ol 'nerve impulses' i go long olgeta hap bilong bodi na mekim blut i ron na tu, em i mekim blut i go gut long olgeta hap bilong bodi.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Ol dispela 'nerve impulses' em ol i save go aut hariap tru long olgeta hap bilong bodi we i save helpim long mekim bodi i stap seif long ol samting we i ken bagarapim em.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Ol 'tornado' i save kamap long wanpela liklik eria taim yu skelim ol wantaim ol narapela strongpela win na ren, tasol em i save bagarapim tru olgeta samting we i stap long rot bilong em.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Ol 'tornado' i save kamautim ol diwai, rausim ruf bilong ol bilding, na apim na tromoi ol kar i go antap long skai. Ol 'tornado' nogut we i kamapim tupela pesen (percent) bilong olgeta 'tornado' em ol save stap moa long tripela aua.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Ol dispela 'monster storm' i gat win we i spit i go long mak bilong 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Ol manmeri i bin mekim na yusim ol 'lenses' long mekim ol samting i kamap bikpela long planti tausen yia.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Tasol, ol trupela 'telescope' ol i bin wok long Europe long klostu pinis bilong '16th century'.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Ol dispela 'telescope' we ol i yusim em ol i gat tuplela 'lens' we ol i bungim wantaim long mekim ol samting i luk olsem ol i stap klostu na ol i bikpela.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Pasin bilong gridi na tingim yumi yet em bai i stap wantaim mipela olgeta taim na wanpela samting long pasin bilong wok bung em i olsem, olgeta manmeri i ken kisim gutpela samting tasol wanpela i ken kisim moa samting long sotpela taim sapos em i tingim em yet.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Em bai i gutpela moa, planti manmeri bai luksave olsem em i gutpela long longpela taim bihain sapos ol i wok bung wantaim ol narapela.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Planti manmeri i driman i long dispela de we ol manmeri i ken i go long narapela sta na lukim ol narapela wol, sampela manmeri i tingting long wanem samting i stap longwe na sampela i bilip olsem ol 'alien' o ol narapela samting i gat laik i stap long ol narapela plenet (planet).
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Tasol, sapos dispela bai kamp em bai no inap long kamap i go inap longpela taim bihain. Ol sta i stap long olgeta hap na i gat trilien (trillion) 'mile' i stap namel long ol sta we i stap "klostu klostu".
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Ating long wanpela de, ol tumbuna pikinini bilong yu long sanap antap long wol bilong ol 'alien' na tingting bek long ol tumbuna papamama bilong ol?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Ol planti 'cell' i kamapim ol animal. Ol i save kaikai samting na kaikai i save stap insait long bel bilong ol. Klostu olgeta bilong ol animal i ken muv.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Ol animal tasol i gat ol brein (tasol i no olgeta animal i gat brein; eksampel, em ol jelifis (jellyfish), ol i no gat brein).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Ol animal i stap long olgeta hap bilong graun. Ol i dik i go insait long graun, ol i swim long solwara, ol i flai long skai.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Wanpela 'cell' em i wanpela liklik samting we i gat straka na i save mekim wok insait long wanpela samting ol insait long ol samting i gat laip.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Dispela hap tok 'cell' em i kam long tok ples Latin 'cella' we i min olsem wanpela liklik rum.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Sapos yu lukluk long ol samting i stap aninit long wanpela 'microscope', yu bai lukim olsem ol i gat planti ol samting we i luk olsem ol liklik bal o liklik 'square'.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, wanpela baiolojist (biologist) bilong England, i lukim ol dispela liklik 'square' insait long wanpela 'cork' wantaim wanpela 'microscope'.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Ol i luk olsem ol rum. Em i namba wan man long lukim ol 'cell' we i dai pinis.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Ol elemen (element) na kompaun (compound) i ken senis long wanpela steit (state) i go long narapela na i stap wankain elemen o kompaun yet.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrogen olsem wanpela ges (gas) em i gat ol wankain propeti (properties) olsem wanpela 'nitrogen' taim em i stap olsem wara. Dispela 'liquid state' em i paspas moa tasol ol 'molecule' i wankain yet.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Wara em i narapela eksampel. Dispela kompaun (compound) i gat tupela 'hydrogen atom' na wanpela 'oxygen atom'.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Em i gat wankain 'molecular structure' maski em i wanpela win, wara, o stronpela samting.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Maski 'physical state' bilong em i ken senis, 'chemical state' i stap wankain yet.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Taim em i samting we i stap long olgeta hap na i raunim mipela, na em i save stap insait long olgeta samting yumi mekim, tasol i hat yet long klia gut long em.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Ol lain bilong lotu, ol saveman bilong skelim ol tingting na pasin, na ol saveman bilong sains (science) i bin stadim taim long planti tausen yia.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Yumi save ol taim i kamap taim ol samting i laik kamap i kamap na i go pinis.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Na tu, taim em i wanem we yumi skelim longpela ('length') bilong ol samting we i kamap.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Yu yet i ken soim olsem taim em i kam i go taim yu lukluk long ol 'cyclic event' we i save kamap olgeta taim. Wanpela 'cyclic event' em i wanpela samting we i save kamap olgeta taim long olgeta taim.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Tude ol i save yusim ol komputa long senisim ol piksa na vidio.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Sampela ol katun we i narakain em ol i ken wokim ol long ol konputa, na dispela kain katun em ol i wok long yusim moa yet insait long ol televisen (television) na muvi.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Planti taim ol i save yusim ol narapela kain komputa long rekodim musik bai em i ken proesesim (process) na miksim ol saun wantaim.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Longpela taim namel long 'nineteenth' na 'twentieth century', ol i bin bilong olsem ol namba wan lain we i stap long New Zealand em ol Maori lain, husat i save kaikai ol bikpela pisim ol i kolim 'moas'.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Ol i kamapim tingting olsem ol Maori lain i stap long Polynesia insait long wanpela Great Fleet we i kisim ol i go long New Zealand na ol i kisim dispela ples long ol Moriori, na kamapim wanpela sosaieti we i save wokim gaden.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Tasol, nupela evidens (evidence) i tok olsem ol Moriori em ol i wanpela grup bilong ol Maori husat i stap long New Zealand na i go long Chatham Islands, na kamapim nupela kalsa bilong ol yet, na em i wanpela kalsa bilong stap isi na stap gut.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: I bin i gat wanpela narapela lain i stap long Chatham islands na dispela ol lain em ol Maori husat i lusim New Zealand na i go long hap.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Ol i kolim ol yet olsem ol Moriori na i bin gat sampela pait i kamap i go na bihain, olgeta Moriori i dai.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
