text: Ol wanwan manmeri husat i bin mekim dispela wok long sampela ten yia i bin helpim yumi long luksave long ol samting we yumi i inap long mekim na ol samting yumi i save laikim taim ol i skelim ol samting we i bin hat na ol samting we yumi i no mekim.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Taim yumi putim yau na harim ol wanwan manmeri i toktok long stori bilong ol yet, bilong famili na bilong oganaisesen, yumi kisim planti gutpela tingting long wanem samting i bin kamap long bipo na sampela bilong ol impoten lain husat i bin mekim gutpela samting o samting nogut i kamap insait long kalsa bilong oganaisesen.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Taim yumi klia gut long histori bilong wanpela dispela em i no min olsem yumi klia gut long kalsa, em i helpim ol manmeri long save wanem hap ol i stap long en insait long histori bilong oganaisesen.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Taim yumi skelim ol samting yumi bin mekim gut na luksave long ol samting we yumi i no mekim gut, ol wanwan manmeri na olgeta lain we i stap insait long dispela bung i painimaut long ol velu (value), ol misen (mission), na ol samting we i save mekim oganaisesen i wok gut.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Long dispela taim, ol i tingim bek ol taim we ol i bin mekim ol 'entrepreneurial behavior' na ol gutpela samting we i kamap i helpim ol manmeri long mekim ol nupela senis na ol nupela senis bilong lokel sios.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Ol dispela kain 'success story' i daunim ol pret we ol lain i gat long mekim senis, na i kamapim ol gutpela tingting long senis long kamap long bihaintaim.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: 'Convergent thinking' em i wanpela teknik bilong painim ansa bilong wanpela problem na em i save bungim ol kainkain tingting o ol kainkain save long painim ansa bilong wanpela problem.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: As bilong dispela kain tingting em pasin bilong mekim samting hariap, skelim samting gut na mekim samting stret, na pasin bilong luksave long ol trupela samting, yusim gen ol teknik we i stap pinis na kisim infomesen.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Impoten samting tru long dispela kain tingting em i olsem: i gat wanpela stretpela ansa tasol. Yu ken tingim tupela ansa, tasol wanpela em i stret na narapela em i rong.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Dispela kain tingting em i bilong wok wantaim sampela kain sains o stendet prosidia (standard procedure).
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Ol manmeri wantaim dispela kain tingting em ol i gat 'logical thinking', na ol i inap long putim ol peten insait long tingting, painim ansa long ol problem na wok long ol test bilong sains.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Ol manmeri em ol i nambawan 'specie' tru we i gat pasin bilong ritim tingting bilong ol narapela.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Dispela em i min olsem yumi i inap long save wanem samting ol narapela manmeri i lukim, i laik mekim, i bilip long en, i save long en o i laik long i gat.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Namel long ol dispela pasin, pasin bilong save long tingting bilong narapela em i impoten. Em i helpim mipela long stretim ol samting we i no klia insait long ol eksen bilong mipela.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Eksampel, sapos yu lukim wanpela i wok long brukim windua bilong kar, yu bai ting olsem em i wok long traim long stil long kar bilong wanpela narapela man.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Yu bai skelim em long narapela kain we sapos em i bin lusim ki bilong kar na dispela em i kar bilong em yet we em i wok long traim na brukim.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI em i wanpela samting long sait bilong 'physics' we ol i kolim 'nuclear magnetic resonance' (NMR), we Felix Bloch na Edward Purcell i bin painimaut long 1930s taim (Felix i wok long Stanford University) na (Edward i wok long Havard University).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Insait long 'resonance', dispela 'magnetic field' na ol 'radio waves' i mekim ol 'atom' i givim ol liklik redio siknel (signal).
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Long yia 1970, Raymond Damadian, wanpela 'medical doctor' na 'research scientist', i painimaut wanem we bilong yusim 'magnetic resonance imaging' olsem wanpela tul (tool) bilong painimaut sik.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Foapela yia bihain ol i kisim wanpela laisens (licence), na dispela em i namba wan laisen long olgeta hap bilong graun long eria bilong MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Long 1977, Dr. Damadian i pinisim konstraksen (construction) bilong namba wan MRI scanner bilong “olgeta hap bilong bodi”, na em i kolim em ”Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: 'Asynchronous communication' i save sapotim pasin bilong givim taim long tingting long ol samting na putim ya na toktok long ol narapela.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Em i mekim ol sumating i gat taim long wok long spit na mak bilong ol yet na kontrolim mak we ol i kisim tok skul.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Na tu, i no gat planti mak i stap long taim bilong mekim wok na i mekim isi long wok long taim bilong yu yet. (Bremer, 1998).
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Pasin bilong yusim Internet an World Wide Web i mekim ol lain i save lainim samting long kisim infomesen we ol i nidim long olgeta taim.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Ol sumatin i ken salim ol kwesten i go long tisa long kainkain taim bilong de na ol i ken kisim bekim hariap, na ol i no inap long wet inap ol i lukim tisa 'face-to-face'.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: 'Postmodern' rot bilong lainim samting em i save givim fridom long bihainim wanpela rot tasol. I no gat wanpela gutpela wanpela we bilong lainim samting.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Em i tru olsem, i no gat wanpela gutpela samting long lainim. Pasin bilong lainim samting em i save kamap namel long sumatin na samting ol i givim em long lainim.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Wanem samting yumi save lukim nau long sait bilong 'do-it-yourself' na givim infomesen, na lainim samting long ol 'television show' i soim dispela poin we mipela i toktok long en.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Olsem planti bilong yumi i save lukluk long televisen progrem we i tokim mipela long wanpela samting we mipela bai i no inap long stap insait long en o mipela i no inap long yusim dispela save we mipela i kisim.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Mipela bai i no inap long pulim wanpela kar, wokim wanpela 'fountain' long baksait long haus bilong mipela, go long Peru long lukim ol samting bilong bipo, long mekim nupela stail i kamap long haus bilong mipela.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Tenkyu long ol 'undersea fibre optic cable' we i konektim Europe na 'broadband satellite', Greenland em i konek (connect) gut na 93% bilong populeseen (population) bilong em i ken kisim intanet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotel bilong yu o ol lain i lukautim yu (isapos yu stap insait long wanpela 'guesthouse'o 'private home') yu ken i gat 'wifi' o komputa we i konek long intanet, na olgeta setelmen (settlement) i gat wanpela 'internet cafe' o sampela lokesen we i gat pablik 'wifi'.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Olsem mipela i bin tok pinis long antap, maski dispela wod "Eskimo" em planti lain i save yusim long United States, ol asples manmeri long Artic, na planti moa long Canada i no save laikim dispela tok long wanem em i min olsem ol narapela i no laikim ol.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Maski yu ken harim ol Greenland Natives i yusim dispela tok, ol lain long narapela kantri i mas no ken yusim dispela hap tok.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Ol asples manmeri bilong Greenland i save kolim ol yet olsem ol Inuit long Canada na ol Kalaalleq (moa long wanpela em Kalaallit), na Greenlander, long kantri Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Sampela bikhet pasin, na sampela pasin nogut long lain i kam long narapela ples, dispela em i no save kamap long Greenland. Maski long ol taun, i no gat ol "ples nogut."
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Kolpela weda (weather) ating em tasol em i wanpela trupela birua we ol lain i no redi long en bai i bungim.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Sapos yu go raun na lukim Greenland long taim bilong kol em i impoten olsem yu mas kisim kol klos, (tingim taim yu go moa long hap not, ples bai i kol moa).
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Dispela ol lonpela de tru long sama (summer) i ken mekim ol lain i no slip gut na i kamap ol hevi long sait bilong helt.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Long taim bilong sama (summer), yu mas lukaut tu long ol Nordic moskito (mosquito). Maski ol i no save givim sik, ol i ken mekim skin i skrap.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Maski ekonomi (economy) bilong San Francisco em i konek (connect) wantaim 'world-cla tourist attraction', em i save mekim mani long kainkain rot.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Nambawan eria we i save kisim ol manmeri long wok em ol kampani we i save givim profesenol sevis, gavman, fainens, treid (trade), na ol kampani we i save givim sevis long ol turis.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Olgeta taim ol i save soim em insait long musik, muvi, stori, na kalsa bilong tude na dispela i mekim planti manmeri long olgeta hap bilong graun i save long dispela siti.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco i kamapim wanpela a bikpela namba bilong ol samting we i save sevis long ol turis we i gat planti hotel, 'restaurant', na ol fesiliti (facility) we i gat bihainim ol nambawan stendet.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Na tu, Fransisco em i wanpela bilong ol nambawan ples insait long kantri long painim kaikai bilong Asia: ol i gat Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Pasin bilong raun i go long Walt Disney World em i wanpela bikpela raun we planti famili long America i save mekim.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Ol samting "i save kamap olgeta taim" em bai yu flai i go long Orlando International Airport, kalap long bas (bus) i go long wanpela Disney hotel we i stap long dispela hap, stap long wanpela wik na i go autsait long propeti bilong Disney, na go bek long haus.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: I gat kainkain senis i ken kamap, tasol dispela em i ol samting we planti manmeri i save mekim taim ol tok olsem ol "i go long Disney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Planti tiket we ol i save salim long intanet long ol websait kain olsem eBay o Craigslist em ol i ken yusim long lukim moa long wanpela park long moa long wanpela de.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Maski planti lain i save mekim dispela samting, Disney i tok tambu long dispela: ol dispela tiket em i bilong wanpela man na ol i no ken salim long narapela man.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Long mekim sampela kain liklik 'camping' long Grand Canyon, yu mas kisim wanpela tok orait long go long ol liklik ples longwe long siti.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Ol i putim mak long namba bilong tok orait bikos ol i laik lukautim 'canyon', na em bai i op long namba 1 de bilong mun long ol lain i ken makim spes bilong ol long i go, foapela mun bipo long mun we 'canyon' bai i op.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Olsem na, tok orait bilong i go long ol liklik ples we i stap longwe long siti long mun Mei bai i redi long de namba 1 bilong mun Jenueri.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Spes bilong i stap long ol ples we planti manmeri i save laikim, i save pulap hariap long namba wan de ol i open long ol manmeri long makim spes, dispela em ol kain ples olsem Bright Angel Campground we i stap sait long Phantom Ranch.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: I gat mak bilong namba bilong tok orait we ol i ken givim long ol lain we i wokabaut i go insait long ofis bilong ol na mekim rikwes, na ol bai givim spes long husat ol lain i kam pas.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Go long Southern Africa long kar em i wanpela we bilong lukim olgeta naispela samting bilong dispela rijen na tu long kisim ol narapela rot na go long ol ples we ol turis i save go long em.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Dispela em i yu ken mekim wantaim wanpela nomol kar taim yu mekim gut plen, tasol i gutpela moa long yuim 4x4 kar na planti ol hap em yu ken go long en wantaim wanpela 'high wheel base' 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Taim yu mekim plen yu mas tingim olsem maski Southern Africa i stap gut ol narapela kantri i stap klostu long en em ol i no stap gut.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Kost na nid bilong i gat wanpela visa em i save senis long wanpela kantri i go long narapela na dispela em bai bihainim wanem kantri yu kam long en.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Wanwan kantru tu i gat ol narakain lo bilong em yet long wanem ol samting bilong imejensi (emergency) yu ken karim insait long kar.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls em i wanpela taun long hap wes bilong Zimbabwe, kalapim boda long Livinstone Zambia, na klostu long Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Dispela taun em i stap arere tasol long 'falls', na ol i save pulim planti turis, tasol dispela ples em i gutpela long ol lain i painim 'adventure' na ol lain i laik lukim ol samting long i stap longpela taim.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Long taim bilong ren (Novemba i go long Mas), vmak bilong wara bai i go antap na Falls bai i luk bikpela moa.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Yu bai wet sapos yu wokabaut long bris o wokabaut long ol liklik rot we i stap klostu long Falls.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Tasol narapela sait, em i bikos mak bilong wara em i bikpela tru olsem na yu bai no inap long lukim Falls—bikos sais bilong wara i blokim ples bilong lukluk!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 em i wanpela 'tomb' bilong Valley we planti lain tru i save long en, em i wanklain olsem piksa bilong Howard Carter taim em i painim dispela 'tomb' bilong yangpela king i stap gut tru long 1922.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Taim yu skelim wantaim ol narapela 'tomb' bilong king na kwin, dispela 'tomb' bilong Tutankhamun em planti lain bai i no gat tingting long go lukim bikos sais bilong em i liklik na em i no gat planti bilas.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Wanpela man o meri we i gat intres long lukim evidens (evidence) bilong bagarap long 'mummy' long taim ol i laik traim long rausim em long kofin bai i no inap amamas biks het na solda (shoulder) i stap ples klia.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Ol naispela kago we i stap long ol 'tomb' i no stap moa. tasol ol i putim ol long Egyptian Museum long Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Ol visita (visiter) we i no gat inap taim bilong raun i ken spendim taim bilong ol long sampela narapela hap.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, em i stap 12 km 'southwest' long Siem Reap. Tempel i stap antap long liklik maunten em ol i bin wokim long pinis bilong '9th century', long taim King Yasovarman i stap olsem king.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Dispela ples we i no gat lait insait long tempel na naispela hap bilong lukluk antap long raunwara Tonle Sap i mekim dispela wok we yu mekim long klaimim maunten em i no lus nating.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Wanpela raun i go long dispela hap em yu ken bungim i go wantaim wanpela raun long bot i go long raunwara.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass em yu bai nidim long i go insait long tempel olsem na no ken lus tingtin long bringim paspot (passport) i go wantaim yu taim yu golong Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem em i kapitol na bikpela siti tru bilong Israel, maski planti narapela kantri na United Nations i no luksave long Israel olsem kapitol bilong em.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Dispela siti bilong bipo i stap long Judean Hills me i gat wanpela narapela kain histori (history) bilong em yet we i go bak long planti tausen yia.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Dispela siti em i holi long tripela lotu we i save bilip long wanpela God - Judaism, Christianity na Islam, na em i save stp olsem senta bilong lotu, bilip, na kalsa.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Bikos long impoten mining bilong dispela siti long sait bilong lotu, na ol hap we i stap long eria bilong Old City, Jerusalem em i wanpela hap we i save pulim planti turis.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalem i gat planti ples bilong histori, kalsa na akeoloji (archeology), wantaim planti hap bilong baim samting, baim kaikai, na 'restaurant'.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Lo bilong Ecuador i tok olsem ol sitisen bilong Cuba i mas kisim wanpela pas we i askim ol long go long Ecuador bipo long ol i ken yusim ol intanesinel eapot o ol 'frontier admission points' long kam long em.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Dispela leta em Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs i mas tok orait long em, na em i mas bihainim sampela samting.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ol dispela samting we ol i mas mekim em i bilong mekim wanpela gutpela balens i kamap long namba bilong ol manmeri i go i kam long dispela tupela kantri.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Ol sitisen bilong Cuba husat i holim 'US green card' em ol i mas go long wanpela Ecuadorian Consulate long kisim wanpela pepa i tok olsem ol i no gat nid long i gat wanpela pas i askim ol long i go.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Paspot (passport) bilong yu em i mas 'valid' long 6-pela mun o moa long de we yu bai travel. Yu bai nidim wanpela 'round/onward' tiket long soim hamas taim yu bai stap long hap.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ol 'tour' i go long dispela hap em i no bikpela mani long ol bikpela grup, olsem na sapos yu go yu yet o wantaim wanpela pren, traim long bungim ol narapela manmeri na kamapim wanpela grup we o gat foapela o sikspela lain long kisim wanpela gutpela reit (rate).
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Tasol, dispela em wanpela samting we yu no ken wari long en, bikos ol turis em ol i save bungim ol wantaim long pulapim ol kar.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Em i luk olsem wanpela rot bilong trikim ol manmeri long bilip olsem ol i mas baim moa mani.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Sanap longpela moa long hap not bilong Machu Picchu em wanpela longpela maunten, planti taim em i save stap baksait long ol foto bilong ol bilding bilong bipo.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Em i luk olsem wanpela hat long klaimim taim yu stap daunbilo, na em i sap na i hat long go antap, tasol wanpela man o meri we i strong i ken i go antap long kain taim olsem 45 minit.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Ol i putim ol ston step long rot bilong wokabaut, na long ol hap we i sap moa i gat ol 'steel cable' bilong givim sapot bilong holim han.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Yumi tok olsem pinis, tasol yu mas save olsem yu bai sotwin, lukaut gut long ol ples we i sap, lukaut moa yet long taim ples i wet, em i ken kamapim birua hariap.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: I gat wanpela hul bilong ston i stap klostu long antap we yu mas go insait long en, em i sotpela na i gat liklik spes bilong 'squeeze' na i go insait.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Long lukim ol ples na animal bilong Galapago em i gutpela moa long rong long bot, wankain olsem Charles Darwin i bin mekim long 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Moa long 60-pela 'cruise ship' i save go long ol wara bilongt Galapagos ‑ stat long sais bilong 8-pela pasindia i go long sais bilong 100-pela pasindia.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Planti manmeri i save makim ples bilong ol bipo yet (bikos ol bot i save pulap long taim we planti manmeri i save laikim).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Yu mas sekim gut olsem dispela 'agent' we yu tokim em long makim spes em i wanpela man o meri we i gat planti save long Galapagos na ol kainkain sip.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Dispela em bai mekim na ol intres bilong yu o ol sampela samting we yu no inap long em ol i makim gut wanpela sip long inapim ol dispela nid.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Bipo long ol lain Spain i kam kamap long '16th century', ol Inca i bin bosim 'nothern' Chile taim ol aspela lain Araucanians (Mapuche) i stap long 'central' na 'southern' Chile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Ol Mapuche em ol laspela tumbuna bilong ol asples lain bilong America, we i no kamap olsem pat bilong ol lain i kam aninit long Spain na i save tok ples Spanish i go inap bihain long Chile i kisim indipendens (independence).
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Maski ol Chile i tokaut olsem ol indipenden long 1810 (namel long Napoleonis woa i mekim ol Spain i no gat wanpela gavman long sampela yia), ol i no winim Spain i go inap 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominican Republic (Tok Ples bilong Spain: República Dominicana) em i wanpela kantri bilong Caribbean we i stap insait long hap ist bilong ailan Hispaniola, na i serim dispela ailan wantaim kantri Haiti
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Dispela kantri i gat ol nambis we i gat waitpela wesan na ol maunten, na tu em i gat olpela siti tru long Americas i stap long en. Nau, dispela siti i stap insait long Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Dispela ailan em ol Tainos na Caribes em ol namba wan lain husat i bin i kam na sindaun long em. Ol Caribes em ol lain we i save tok ples Arawaken na ol i bin kam long yia 10,000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Bihain long sampela yia long taim we ol eksplora (explorer) bilong Europe i kam, ol lain bilong Spain i bin daunim namba bilong ol manmeri long Tainos i go daun olgeta.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Fray Bartolomé de la Casas (Tratado de las Indias) i bin tok olsem namel long 1942 na 1498 ol lain bilong Spain we i kam na bosim dispela hap i bin kilim 100,000 Taínos manmeri.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Dispela spes we ol i bin bildim olsem wanpela ples bilong bung bilong wanpela konven (convent) bilong '17th century', em Templo de San Diego i wanpela bilding tasol we i sanap yet.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Nau em i stap olsem wanpela bikpela 'plaza', na olgeta taim i save i gat planti samting i kamap long hap, long de na nait.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: I gat sampela 'restaurant' i raunim dispela gaden, na long ol avinun na nait i save i gat ol fri konset (concert) we ol i save givim long wanpela liklik haus we i stap namel long dispela ples.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Tupela 'balcony' we i gat 69 'centimeter' spes i stap namel long tupela em i ples bilong wanpela 'love legend'.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Sapos yu givim sampela 'penny' sampela pikinin bai tokim yu dispela stori.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island em i wanpela ailan we planti lain i save long en long kisim wanpela raun long de o wanpela wiken raun na ol i save givim 'kayaking', 'hiking', ol stua, 'restaurant', na moa.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Dispela trupela komuniti we i stap long Howe Sound autsait tasol long Vancouver, na em i isi long go long en long wanpela 'water taxi' we i save lusim Granville Island ilong 'downtown' Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Long ol lain husat i save amamas long raun raun, wanpela wokabaut i go antap long ples bilong Sea to Sky em bai inapim laik bilong yu.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1.5 aua draiv lusim Vancouver) em i ekspensif (expensive), tasol planti lain i save long en bikos long 2010 Winter Olympics.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Long taim bilong winta (winter), amamas wantaim sampela nambawan ples bilong ski long North America, na long sama (summer) traim sampela trupela 'mountain biking'.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Yu mas kisim tok orait bipo long yu go long hap. Yu mas i gat tok orait long stap long nait long Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sierna em i wanpela 'ranger station' we i save givim ples bilong slip na kaikai wantaim 'camping'. La Loena, San Pedrillo, na Los Patos i save givim 'camping' tasol na i o gat sevis bilong givim kaikai.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Em i isi long kisim ol tok orait bilong go long park long Ranger Station long Puerto Jiménez, tasol ol i no save yusim ol 'credit card'.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Park Service (MINAE) i no save givim ol tok orait bilong go long park wanpela mun bipo long taim we yu bai go long park.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol i save givim wanpela 'reservation service' long wanpela prais bilong US$30, o $10 long ol 'one-day pass'; ol tok save i stap long Corcovado pes bilong ol.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Ol Cook Islands em ol wanpela ailan kantri long we i save wok bung wantaim New Zealand, na em i stap long Polynesa, long namel bilong South Pacific Ocean.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Em i wanpela grup ailan wantaim 15-pela ailan we i slip antap long 2.2 milien km2 bilong solwara.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Wantaim wankain 'time zone' olsem Hawaii, ol dispela ailan em sampela taim ol i save kolim ol olsem "'Hawaii down under'".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Maski em i liklik, em i mekim sampela ol lain we i bin go lukim Hawaii bipo long em i kamap olsem wanpela steit (state) na i no gat ol bikpela hotel bilong turis na ol narapela divelopmen.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Cooks Island i no gat wanpela siti, tasol em i gat 15-pela kainkain ailan. Ol bikpela ailan em Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Long ol divelop kantri tude, pasin bilong givim wanpela 'deluxe bed' na brekfas em ol i mekim i go kamap olsem wanpela kain 'art-form'.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Long ol lain we i save givim nambawan sevis, B&Bs i save resis long tupela bikpela samting: 'bedding' na brekfas (breakfast).
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Olsem na, long ol nambawan institusen wanpela bai painim ol naispela 'bedding' tru, ating wanpela 'quilt' we ol wokim long han o wanpela 'antique' bed.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Brekfas (breakfast) em bai gat ol naispela kaikai bilong dispela sisen (season) o spesol kaikai bilong dispela hotel.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Ples bilong sindaun em ol bai bilasim olsem wanpela bilding bilng bipo wantaim ol 'antique' bilas, gras ol i katim gut na wanpela 'swimming pool'.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kisim kar bilong yu na go long wanpela longpela 'road trip' em i isi long mekim na em bai mekim yu pilim nais.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: I no kain olsem ol bikpela kar, yu bai save pinis long dravim kar bilong yu na yu save long wanem samting em i no inap long mekim.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Sanapim wanpela haus sek long banis bilong sampela lain o insait long wanpela taun i ken mekim ol manmeri kam lukluk o toktok long yu.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Long mekim sotpela tok, yusim kar bilong yu yet wanpela gutpela rot bilong go graun long rot, tasol em i no wanpela gutpela we bilong mekim "'camp'".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: 'Car camping' em i isi long mekim sapos yu gat wanpela bikpela 'minivan', SUV, Sedan o Station Wagon we i gat sit bilong putim go daun.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Sampela hotel i gat wanpela 'heritage' i kam long taim bilong ol 'steam railways' na 'ocean liners'; bipo long Second World War, long '19th' o stat bilong '20th century'.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Ol dispela hotel em ol ples we ol maniman na bikman bilong dispela taim i save stap long en, na planti taim ol save gat naispela kaikai na gutpela ektiviti bilong mekim long nait.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Dispela ol bilas bilong bipo, na ol i no yusim ol samting bilong tude, na kain olpela na naispela kondisen bilong ol samting bilong bipo em i pat bilong stail bilong ol.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Maski ol i privet propeti bilong sampela lain, ol i ken kisim ol bikman bilong kantri na ol narapela impoten manmeri taim ol i kam.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Wanpela travela (traveller) we i gat planti mani i ken tingting long raun long olgeta hap bilong graun, na i stap long planti bilong ol dispela kain hotel.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Wanpela 'hospitality exchange network' em i wanpela oganaisesen we i save konektim ol travela wantaim ol lokel manmeri long siti we ol bai i go na raun long en.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Long joinim wanpela kain 'network' yu bai nid long pulapim wanpela 'online form'; maski sampela 'network' bai laikim sampela moa dokumen bilong soim.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Ol bai givim wanpela list bilong ol 'host'long intanet/bilong printim, sampela wantaim 'reference' na 'review' we ol narapela travela (traveller) i givim.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing i bin stat long Jenueri 2004 bihain long wanpela 'computer programmer' Casey Fenton i pasin balus i go long Iceland long liklik prais, tasol em i no gat ples long i stap.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Em i imeilim ol sumatin long lokel univesiti na kisim bikpela namba bilong ol lain i laik givim em haus long stap.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Ol 'hostel' em i bilong ol yanpela manmeri – wanpela 'guest' bilong en em bai stap long mak bilong ol twentipela krismas – tasol yu ken painim ol olpela travela tu i stap long hap.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Ol famili wantaim ol pikinini i no save stap long 'hostel', tasol sampela 'hostel' i save larim ol i stap long ol praivet rum.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Dispela siti bilong Beijing long China em bai kamap olsem 'host city' bilong Olympic Winter Games long 2022, dispela bai i mekim em i kamap olsem namba wan siti bilong kamap 'host' bilong winta (winter) na sama (summer) Olympics.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing bai hostim (host) 'opening' na 'closing' seremoni na ol 'indoor ice events'.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Ol narapela 'skiing events' bai kamap long Taizicheng ski eria long Zhangjiakou, kain olsem 220 km (140 'miles') long Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Planti bilong ol dispela tempel i gat wanpela Annual bikde we i stat long Novemba na i pinis long Mid of May, we i save senis senis bihain kalenda bilong wanwan tempel long olgeta yia.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Planti bilong bikde bilong tempel em ol i save amamasim olsem pat bilong 'anniversary' bilong tempel o bon de bilong wanpela god o wanpela bikpela samting bilong dispela tempel.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Ol bikde bilong tempel long Kerala em ol i narakain na yu bai laik long lukim, ol i save wokabaut wantaim ol elefen, ol lain bilong pilai musik long tempel na ol narapela samting bilong amamasim dispela de,
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: World's Fair (narapela nem we planti lain i save long en em World Exposition, o Expo) em i wanpela intanesinel festivel bilong 'art' na 'science'.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Ol kantri we i stap insait long dispela festivel na i soim ol samting bilong ol long 'art' na 'edukesen long ol bilding bilong ol long soim ol hevi i kamap long wol o kalsa na histori bilong kantri bilong ol.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: nternational Horticultural Expositions em ol bung bilong soim flawa, ol 'botanical garden' na ol narapela samting long sait bilong ol plent (plant).
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Maski ol i tok olsem em i ken kamap long olgeta yia (sapos ol i no kamap long ol narapela narapela kantri), tru tru ol i no save kamap long narapela narapela kantri.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Ol dispela samting i save stap long kain mak olsem tripela na sikspela mun, na ol save holim ol long ol ples we i liklik moa long 50 'hectare'.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: I gat planti kainkain fomet (format) bilong film we ol i bin yusim long ol yia i go pinis. Stendet 35 mm film (36 by 24 negatif) em planti lain tru i save long en.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Ol i ken senisim em isi taim em i pinis, na em i save givim 'resolution' we i klostu wankain olsem 'resolution' bilong DSLR bilong tude.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Sampela 'medium‑format' film kamera i save yusim wanpela '6 by 6 cm' fomet, tru tru em i '56 by 56 mm' negatif.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Dispela i save givim 'resolution' we i kain olsem foapela taim moa long wanpela '35 mm' negatif (3136 mm2 versus 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Ol wel animal em ol hatpela samting long ol 'photographer' long kisim, na ol i nidim 'good luck', pasin bilong stap isi na wet, ekspiriens na gutpela ikwipmen (equipment).
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: 'Wildlife photography' em wanpela samting we mipela i no save tingim hatwok i stap baksait long dispela, tasol wankain ol olgeta narapela foto, wanpela piksa em i inap long tausenpela wod.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: 'Wildlife photography' em i nidim wanpela longpela 'telephoto lens', tasol long ol narapela samting olsem ol grup pisin o wanpela liklik animal em bai i nidim ol narapela 'lens'.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Planti ol narakain animal em i hat long painim ol, na sampela taim sampela park i gat ol lo bilong kisim foto sapos yu bai mekim mani long dispela foto.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Ol wel animal i ken sem o i ken kros. Envairomen i ken kol, hot, o i no isi long stap long en.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Olgeta hap bilong graun i gat moa long 5,000 kainkain tok ples, twentipela bilong ol dispela tok ples i gat 50 milien o moa manmeri i save yusim.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Ol toktok ol i raitim em planti taim em i isi moa long save long en na i no ol toktok we ol i tok long maus. Dispela em i tru long ol adres, we i hat moa long kolim na narapela bai i klia long en.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Planti manmeri insait long wanpela kantri i save gut tru long English, na moa yet em yu ken lukim olsem i gat liklik save bilong dispela tok ples i stap ‑ long ol yangpela manmeri.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Tingim, sapos yu inap, wanpela Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican na Sydneysider i sindaun raunim wanpela tebol na kaikai nait kaikai long wanpela 'restaurant' long Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ol i wok long stori long wanpela narapela long ol stori bilong ol taun bilong ol, na ol bai toktok long ol nek na hap tok we i bilong taun bilong ol yet.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Baim sampela kaikai long ol maket em i rot we i no i yusim liklik mani tru long kisim kaikai. Sapos i no gat ples bilong kuk, orait ol kaikai we yu ken baim em bai i no inap planti.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Namba bilong kaikai we i redi long kaikai i wok long i go antap long sekseen bilong kaikai we i redi na i stap. Sampela i save i gat 'micowave oven' o sampela narapela rot bilong hotim kaikai.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Insait long sampela kantri o sampela stoa i gat wanpela 'restaurant' i stap, na em i no 'restaurant' tru tru na ol prais bilong em i no antap tumas.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Mekim na karim kopi bilong ol polisi bilong yu na kontek infomesen bilong 'insurer' bilong yu wantaim yu.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ol bai nid soim imeil adres bilong 'insurer' bilong ol na intanesinel fon namba long kisim tok save/atoraisesen long mekim ol 'claims'.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Yu mas i gat wanpela narapela kopi insait long beg bilong yu na 'online' (salim imeil long yu yet wantaim 'attachment', ol putim long "'cloud'").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Sapos yu raun wantaim wanpela 'laptop' o 'tablet', putim wanpela kopi insait long 'memory' o 'disc' (we yu no inap nidim intanet long kisim).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Na tu, givim kopi bilong polisi/kontek long ol pren we i travel wantaim yu na ol famili o pren long haus we i wanbel long helpim yu.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: 'Moose' (narapela nem bilong en em 'elk) em ol i no save pait wantaim fos, tasol ol i save banisim ol yet long samting we ol i ting olsem i ken bagarapim ol.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Taim ol manmeri i ting olsem ol 'moose' i no inap long kamapim birua, ol i ken i go klostu tumas na putim ol yet long han bilong birua.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Dringim bia long sampela taim. Bia i save wanwan man o meri i kainkain pasin, na em i impoten olsem yu mas save long mak bilong yu.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Ol samting we i ken kamap bihain bikos long pasin bilong dring bia tumas em 'liver' i bagarap na aipas na dai. Mak bilong birua i kamap long pasin bilong dring em i ken i go antap moa taim yumi dring bia we ol i no mekim long stretpela rot.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Ol 'spirit' we lo i tok tambu long en i gat ol kainakin samting insait long en wanpela em 'methanol', dispela i ken kamapim aipas na dai maski yu dring liklik tasol.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Ol aiglas em ol i liklik mani long wanpela narapela kantri, ol i save liklik mani long ol kantri we i save kisim liklik man na kost bilong wok leba (labour) em i daunbilo.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Tingting long kisim wanpela 'eye exam' long haus, yu mas mekim olsem sapos insuren (insurance) i no karampim em, na bringim 'prescription' i go long hap bilong baim aiglas.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Ol ekspensif 'brand‑name' bilong freim (frame) we i stap long ol dispela eria i ken i gat tupela kain problem; sampela ol i ken kopi tasol na i no prodak tru, na ol dispela we ol i importim (imported) em ol bai moa ekspensif long aiglas we ol i wokim yet long kantri.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kofi em i wanpela bilong ol samting we ol manmeri bilong graun i save salim na baim, na yu ken painim kainkain bilong em long rijen bilong yu.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Maski long dispela, i gat ol kainkain we bilong dringim kofi long olgeta hap bilong graun we yu ken eksperiensim.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (o: 'canyoneering') em i toktok long go long aninit bilong wanpela 'canyon', we i drai o i pulap long wara.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: 'Canyoning' em i bungim pasin bilong 'swimming', 'climbing' na 'jumping'‑‑tasol em i no nidim treining (training) o bodi we i fit long stat (taim yu skelim em wantaim eksmapel, 'climbing', 'scuba diving' o 'alpine skiing').
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: 'Hiking' em i wanpela ektiviti bilong mekim long autsait we yu bai wokabaut long envairomen, planti taim long ol rot bilong wokabaut.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: 'Day hiking' em i gat ol mak bilong wokabaut we i aninit long wanpela 'mile' na i go inap long mak bilong wokabaut we wanpela i ken mekim long wanpela de.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Long wanpela 'hike' long wanpela isipela rot em i no gat nid long redi, na wanpela man o meri we i stap helti i ken amamas long wokabaut long en.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Ol famili we i gat ol liklik pikinini i nid long redi gut moa, tasol wanpela de autsait em i isi long mekim wantaim ol bebi na ol 'pre-school' pikinini.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Long intanesinel level, i gat kain olsem 200-pela 'running tour' oganaisesen. Planti bilong ol i save operet long ol yet.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Dispela Go Running Tours, we i kisim ples bilong Global Running Tours i save bungim planti bilong ol 'sightrunning provider' long foapela kontinen (continent).
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Em i bin stat long Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona na Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, Running Tours Prague we i stap long Prague na ol narapela i hariap long joinim em.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: I gat planti samting yu mas tingim pastaim na bihain yu travel i go long sampela hap.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Taim yu travel, yu mas save olsem ol samting i no inap long wankain olsem "ples bilong yu". Ol pasin bilong ol, ol lo, kaikai, rot bilong kar, ples bilong i slip, ol stendet, tok ples na kain olsem bai senis long wanem ples yu stap long en.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Dispela em i samting we yu bai nid long putim insait long het bilong yu, long mekim na yu bai i no inap long amamas o les long pasin bilong ol lokel long mekim samting.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Dispela ol 'travel agency' em ol i bin i stap stat long '19th century'. Wanpela 'travel agent' em i wanpela gutpela rot bilong wanpela raun we i go moa long mak bilong raun long bus, lukim kalsa, tok ples o 'low-income country'.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Maski planti bilong ol 'agency' i wanbel long mekim planti bilong ol 'booking' we planti lain i save mekim, planti 'agent' i save wok long wanpela kain travel, mak bilong mani o ples.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Em i gutpela long yusim wanpela 'agent' husat i save mekim 'booking' long ol wankain raun olsem raun bilong yu.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Lukluk long wanem ol raun ol 'agent' i wok long mekim promosen long en, maski em long wanpela websait o long wanpela windua bilong stoa.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Sapos yu laik long lukim olgeta hap bilong graun long liklik mani, baim wanem samting yu nidim, o salensim yu yet, i gat sampela rot bilong mekim olsem.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Long bikpela rot bilong lukim samting, ol i kam aninit long tupela grup: Yu ken wok taim yu raun o traim na daunim mak bilong mani yu spendim. Dispela hap toktok bai lukluk long pasin bilong daunim mak bilong mani yu spendim.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Long ol lain i sekrifaisim ol gutpela samting, taim na pasin bilong bihain plen na daunim mak bilong mani i go daun klostu long jiro, lukim 'minimum budget travel'.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Dispela tok skul i no min olsem ol travela bai i no inap long stil, go insait long banis we i gat tok tambu long en, salim samting we lo i tok tambu long en, askim long samting, o yusim ol narapela lain long kisim ol samting we ol i laikim.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Wanpela 'immigration checkpoint' em i namba wan stop taim yu kam daun long wanpela balus, sip, ol narapela trenspot (transport).
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Long sampela ples bilong krosim boda ol i save mekim ol trein inspeksen long trein we i wok long ron na yu mas i gat wanpela 'valid ID' wantaim yu taim yu kalap long wanpela bilong ol dispela trein.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Long ol 'sleeper train' bilong nait, 'conductor' i ken kolektim paspot (passport) olsem na yu ken slip gut na ol i no inap distebim yu.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: 'Registration' wanpela samting yu mas mekim insait long wok bilong 'visa'. Insait long sampela kantri, yu mas 'register' olsem yu i stap na adres we yu bai stap long en wantaim ol lokel atoriti.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Long mekim dispela yu bai pulapim wanpela pepa wantaim ol lokel polis o go lukim ol ofis bilong 'immigration'.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Long planti kantri we i gat dispela kain lo, ol lokel hotel bai stretim displela 'registration' long yu (yu mas askim ol).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Long narapela taim, ol lain we i stap autsait long ol ples we ol turis i save stap long en em ol i nid long mekim dispela 'registration'. Tasol, dispela i mekim na lo bai i no inap klia, olsem na yu mas painimaut pastaim.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: 'Architecture' em i wok bilong disainim na konstraktim ol bilding. 'Architecture' bilong wanpela ples i save kamap olsem samting we i save pulim ol turis i go long em.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Planti bilding em ol i nais tru long lukluk long en na piksa bilong ol taim yu stap antap long wanpela longpela bilding o wanpela gutpela posisen long windua em i ken nais tumas.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: 'Architecture' i save bungim ol narapela eria bilong wok kain olsem 'urban planning', 'civil engineering', 'decorative arts', 'interior desigen' na 'landscape design'.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Ol taun bilong en i stap longwe tru, yu no inap long painim planti samting i kamap long nait sapos yu no raun i go long Albuquerque o Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Tasol, klostu olgeta bilong ol 'casino' i stap long list i stap antap i save sevim (serve) ol dring, na sampela bilong ol i save bringim ol 'entertainment brand' (ol dispela 'brand' we i stap raunim Albuquerque na Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Lukaut: ol liklik 'bar' bilong taun em ol i no gutpela ples bilong ol lain long autait long i go long en.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Wanpela samting em i olsem, 'northern' New Mexico i gat bikpela problem wantaim pasin bilong dring bia na draiv, na namba bilong ol draiva we i save dring na draiv i save go antap taim yu go klostu long ol 'bar' bilong ol liklik taun.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Ol peinting (painting) we ol lain i no laikim o ol raiting (writing) we i no gutpela em ol i save kolim olsem 'graffiti'.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Maski em i wanpela samting bilong bipo yet, planti manmeri i save ting olsem em i samting we ol yanpela i save mekim taim ol laim bagarap samting bilong pablik na praivet propeti taim ol i yusim 'spray paint'.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Tasol, nau i gat ol 'graffiti artist', 'graffiti events' na "'legal" walls'. Ol 'graffiti painting' bilong ol dispela lain em i save soim ol 'artwork' na i no ol samting we lo i tambu long em.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Pasin bilong tromoi 'boomerang' em i wanpela samting we planti turis i save lainim.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Sapos yu laik lainim long tromoi wanpela 'boomerang' we i kam bek long han bilong yu, yu mas sekim na lukim olsem yu gat wanpela gutpela 'boomerang' we i ken tanim i kam bek.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Planti ol 'boomerang' i stap long Australia em o i no inap long kam bek. Em i gutpela long ol lain i wok long stat long lainim long no ken traim tromoi long taim bilong win
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Wanpela Hangi Meal em ol i save kukim insait long wanpela hotpela hol long graun.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Dispela hol em ol i save hotim wantaim hotpela ston bilong wanpela paia, ol long sampela ples we i gat hot i save kam aninit long graun.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Planti taim ol i save yusim 'hangi' long kukim wanpela kaikai bilong avinun long paia.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Sampela ples long Rotorua i save givim 'geothermal hangi', na ol narapela 'hangi' em ol lain i ken traim long Christchurch, Wellington na narapela hap.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail i gat tupela level long ol trein bilong i go i kam long wok na raun long Cape Town: MetroPlus (em ol i save kolim olsem First Class) na Metro (ol i save kolim Third Class).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus em i gutpela moa na i no gat planti manmeri, tasol em i moa ekspensif moa, tasol em i liklik mani moa long ol nomol tiket bilong ol trein i save ron aninit long graun long Europe.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Olgeta train i gat MetroPlus na Metro 'coaches'; MetroPlus 'coaches' em ol i save stap long baksait long trein klostu long Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Ol lain i save karim bek bilong ol narapela ‑ No ken lusim ai long bek bilong yu, bikpela moa em taim yu long lusim wanpela intanesinel boda na i go long hapsait.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Yu ken painimaut olsem ol i yusim yu long karim drag (drug) taim yu no save, dispela em bai mekim yu i stap insait long bikpela trabel.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Dispela em yu bai sanap long lain, bikos ol bai i no inap tok save na yusim ol dok bilong smelim drag (drug).
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Sampela kantri i gat bikpela panismen maski em i namba wan taim ol lain i brukim lo; ol dispela kain panismen em man bai go long kalabus long moa long 10-pela yia o dai.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Ol bek we no gat man i was long ol em ol lain i ken stilim na tu, em i ken mekim ol atoriti i tingting planti olsem sampela lain i lusim bom insait long dispela bek.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Long haus, bikos yu save stap wantaim ol dispela lokel jem (germ), i gat bikpela sans olsem yu kamap 'immune' long ol.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Tasol long ol narapela hap bilng graun, long ples we ol bekteria (bacteria) i nupela long yu, i gat bikpela sans olsem yu bai bungim sampela hevi.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Na tu, long ol ples we i hot ol bekteria (bacteria) i ken gro hariap moa na stap longpela taim autsait long bodi.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Olsem na o wip (whip) bilong Delhi Belly, Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, na ol planti pren bilong ol.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Wankain olsem ol problem bilong pulim win long ol ples kol, problem bilong bel rop long ol hotpela ples em i save kamap na planti taim em i save mekim man i les tasol em i no inap kamapim bikpela bagarap.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Sapos yu wok long travel i go long wanprla kantri we i wok long divelop yet long namba wan taim – o long wanpeal nupela hap bilong graun – no ken ting olsem yu no inap long kisim 'culture shock'.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Ol nupela samting insait long wanpela kantri we i wok long divelop yet i bin daunim planti bilong ol gutpela travela (traveler), long wanem ol i nid long mekim planti liklik senis long kalsa na ol dispela liklik senis i bung wantaim na i kamap olsem bikpela samting tumas.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Bikpela moa em long ol de we yu stat, tingim long amamasim yu yet long ol ' Western-style' na -kwaliti hotel, na ol sevis bilong mekim yu lainim long stap long dispela hap.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: No ken slip long wanpela matres o wanpela samting yu putim long graun long ol eria we yu no klia gut long ol lokel animal na binatang.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Sapos yu bai go autsait na mekim kem, bringim wanpela bet bilong kem o wanpela 'hammock' long mekim yu i stap longwe long ol snek, 'scorpion' na kain olsem.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Pulapim haus bilong yu wantaim wanpela naispela kofi long moning na sampela 'chamomile' ti bilong rileks (relax) long nait.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Taim yu stap tasol long haus na holide, yu gat taim long mekim yu yet amamas na kisim sampela taim long mekim wanpela naispela ti o kofi.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Sapos yu pilim olsem yu laik traim sampela nupela samting, kisim dispela taim ling mekim jus o mekim 'smoothies'.
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: ating yu bai painim wanpela isipela dring we yu ken mekim long brekfas (breakfast) taim yu go bek long 'daily routine' bilong yu.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Sapos yu stap long wanpela siti we i gat kainkain kalsa bilong dring, go long ol 'bar', o 'pub' we stap klostu na yu no save go long em planti taim.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Long ol lain we i no klia long hap tok we ol medikel lain i save yusim, dispela tupela hap tok 'infectious' na 'contagious' i gat narapela narapela mining.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Wanpela sik we i isi tru long spred (spread) em sik we wanpela 'pathogen' i kamapim, kain olsem wanpela vaires, bekteria, fangi (fungi) o ol narapela parasait (parasite).
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Wanpela 'contagious' sik em i wanpela sik we i isi tru long kalap i go long narapela man o meri taim yu stap klostu long wanpela man o meri i gat dispela sik.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Planti gavman i tok olsem olgeta visita em kam long kantri bilong ol, ol i lusim wanpela kantri i mas kisim sut marasin bilong banisim ol long ol kainkain sik.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Ol dispela samting we lo i tok long mekim em i senisim bihainim wanem kantri wanpela travela i go long em pinis o i laik go long en.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Wanpela bilong ol gutpela samting long Charlotte, North Carolina, em i olsem i gat planti kwaliti ektiviti bilong ol famili.
