text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Planti taim oll lain i save stap long dispela eria i tok olsem 'family-friendliness' em i wanpela bilong ol nambawan as tingting bilong ol long muv i go long hap, na ol visita i save lukim olsem em i isi long amamas wantaim ol pikinini long hap.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Long 20-pela yia i go pinis, mak bilong ol samting bilong mekim wantaim ol pikinini long Uptown Charlotte em i go antap tru.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ol famili long Charlotte i no save yusim ol teksi, maski ol i ken yusim ol long mekim sampela samting.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: I gat ekstra (extra) kost bilong i gat moa long 2-pela pasindia, olsem na dispela i mekim em i kamap moa ekspensif.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica em i kol ples we i winim ol kol ples long olgeta hap bilong graun na em i stap long South Pole.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Em i bikpela mani long ol turis long i go na lukim dispela ples. Bodi bilong ol turis i mas fit long i go long dispela hap na ol i ken i go long taim bilong sama long Novemba i go long Febueri, na ol i ken i go long Peninsula, Islands na Ross Sea.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Sampela tausen wokmanmeri i save stap hia long sama (summer). Ol i save stap long kain olsem foapela 'dozen' senta long ol dispela eria, liklik namba bilong ol wokmanmeri tasol i save stap long taim bilong winta (winter).
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Insait long Antarctica em ples i flet nating na i gat 2-3 kilomita bilong ais i stap.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Wanwan taim i save i gat balus i go long insait bilong Antarctica long ol lain bilong klaimim maunten o bilong i go long Pole. I gat bikpela 'base' i stap long Pole.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (o Highway) em i wanpela 1600 km rot we i stat long McMurdo Station long Ross Sea na i go long Pole.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Sno bilong em i gat ol hol i go insait long graun na i gat ol plak i makim ol dispela hol. Ol spesol trakta (tractor) tasol i ken ron antap long em na pulim ol plang we i gat saplai na 'fuel' i stap antap.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Ol i no save muv hariap olsem na dispela rot i kisim longpela taim long tanim na raunim Transantarctic Mountains long kam long ol ples antap.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Nambawan samtinbg we i save kamapim ol eksiden long winta (winter) em rot we i welwel, 'pavements' (rot bilong wokabaut long sait), na bikpela moa em ol step.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Long 'minimum' mak, yu bai nidim ol su we i gat ol gutpela aninit bilong em. Ol su bilong sama (summer) em ol i save welwel long ais na sno (snow), maski sampela 'boot' bilong winta (winter) tu i no gutpela.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Peten i mas dip (deep) inap, 5 mm (1/5 inch) o moa, na meteriel em i mas 'soft' inap taim em i stap insait long ol kol tempritsa (temperature).
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Sampela 'bbot' i gat 'stud' na i gat ikwipmen wei gat moa 'stud' long en bilong yusim long ol kondisen we i welwel, na em i gutpela long planti su na 'boot', na long ol 'heel' bilong su o 'heel' na aninit bilong su wantaim.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Ol 'heel' em ol i mas sotpela na i op. Wesan, karanas o sol ('calcium chloride') em planti taim ol i sace tromoi long rot na liklik han rot bilong mekim ol kar na manmeri i no ken wel.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Ol 'avalanche' em ol i no samting we i no nomol; ol sap maunten i ken holim sampela sno tasol, moa sno bai kam daun olsem 'avalanche'.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Problem em i olsem sno em i 'sticky', olsem na em i nidim sampela samting long mekim em i kam daun, na taim sampela sno i kamdaun dispela i ken mekim na olgeta sno i kam daun.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Sampela taim, nambawan samting we i mekim dispela em i san we i mekim sno i hat, sampela taim em sampela moa sno i pundaun, na sampela taim em ol narapela samting, bikpela moa em ol manmeri.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Wanpela 'tornado' em i wanpela longpela win wei gat 'low-pressure air', we i save pulim ol win i stap long sait sait na karim i go antap.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Ol i save kamapim 'high winds' (planti taim em i 100-200 'mile'/'hour') na i ken apim ol hevipela samting i go antap long win, na karim ol i go taim 'tornado' i muv.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Ol i stat taim ol 'funnel' i kam daun long ol klaut bilong win na ren, na i kamap ol "'tornado" taim ol i tasim graun.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) 'provider' em i nambawan we bilong abrusim 'censorship' bilong gavman na 'commercial IP-geofiltering'.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ol i antap moa long ol 'web proxies' bikos long sampela as. Ol i ken senisim 'route' bilong olgeta 'internet traffic', i no http tasol.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Planti taim ol i save givim 'higher bandwidth' na gutpela kwailiti sevis. Ol i 'encrypted' olsem na em i hat long ol lain i 'spy' long ol.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Ol nius kampani i save giaman long wok bilong dispela, ol i save tok olsem dispela em long "stopim 'piracy'".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Tru tru, ol 'region codes' i no senisim wanpela samting long pasin bilong brukim lo na mekim kopi; wanapela ' bit-for-bit' kopi i ken pilai gut long wanpela divai (device) wankain olsem 'original' kopi.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Tru tru wok bilong en em long givim ol kamapi moa kontrol long maket bilong ol; as tingting bilong en em long wokim moa mani.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Bikos ol kol (call) i save go long intanet, yu no nid long yusim wanpela fon kampani we i stap long ples yu stap long en o i stap long ples we yu go long en.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: I no gat wanpela lo we i tok olsem yu niod long kisim wanpela lokel namba long komunit we yu stap insait long en, yu ken kisim wanpela 'satellite Internet connection' long 'wilds of Chicken, long Alaska na makim wanpela namba wei tok olsem yu stap long ples bilong san long Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Planti taim, yu bai wanpela 'global number' long em yet we bai larim ol PSTN fon i ringim yu. Wanem hap dispela namba i kam long en bai mekim sampela senis i kamap long ol lain i ringim yu.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Ol 'real-time text translator apps' – em ol aplikesen we i inap long mekim 'automatic' trenslesen bilong ol hap toktok long wanpela tok ples i no long narapela.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Sampela bilong ol aplikesen insait long dispela grup i ken mekim trenslesen long narapela tok long 'signs' o ol narapela samting we 'user' i poinim smatfon i go long en.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Ol 'translation engine' i kamap gutpela moa moa yet, na ol i save givim ol stretpela trenslesen (na wanwan taim tasol em ol toktok we i no gat mining), tasol yu mas lukaut bikos, ol i ken mekim bikpela asua na tanim olgeta toktok kranki.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Wanpela bilong ol nambawan 'app' insait long dispela grup em Google Translate, we i save mekim ol 'offline' trenslesen taim em i daunlodim olgeta 'language data' we em i nidim.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Pasin bilong yusim ol 'GPS navigation app' long smatfon bilong yu em i isipela we na gutpela we bilong painim wanem hap yu laik go long en taim yu stap autsait long kantri bilong yu.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Em i ken seivim mani bilong baim wanpela nupela mep (map) taim yu yusim wanpela GPS, o wanpela 'standalone' GPS divais (device)o rentim wanpela long wanpela 'car rental company'.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Sapos yu no gat wanpela 'data connection' long fon bilong yu, o taim fon bilong yu i stap 'out of range', pefomens bilong em bai i no inap long wok gut o i no stap.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Olgeta kona stoa i pulap wantaim ol kainkain 'pre-paid' fon kad we yu ken yusim long ol 'pay phone' o long ol telefon.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Maski planti bilong ol dispela kad em i gutpela long ring long olgeta hap, sampela i save givim spesol reit (rate) long ring i go long ol kantri i stap insait long wanpela grup.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Long kisim ol dispela sevis planti taim em yu bai ringim wanpela 'toll-free' telefon namba we yu ken ring long planti fon na i no gat sas bilong em.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Ol rul (rule) bilong 'regular photography' em yu ken yusim long 'video recording', na dispela em i gutpela moa.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Sapos yu kisim foto bilong wanpela samting we i tambu long kisim foto long en, orait yu ken tingting long kisim video bilong em.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Sapos yu yusim wanpela 'drone', sekim gut long wanem samting yu ken kisim foto long en na wanem ol tok orait pepa o narapela laisens em yu mas kisim long mekim dispela.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Flaim wanpela 'drone' klostu long wanpela eapot o antap long wanpela bikpela lain manmeri em i no gutpela, maski lo i no tok tambu long en long eria bilong yu.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Tude raun long balus em wanwan taim tasol i save baim tiket stret long 'airline' na i no mekim 'search' na skelim ol prais.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Sampela taim dispela seim (same) ron bilong balus i ken i gat narapela narapela prais long kainkain 'aregator' na em bai gutpwla long mekim 'search' long websait bilong dispela balus kampani bipo long mekim 'booking'.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Maski yu bai no inap long nidim wanpela 'visa' long mekim ol sotpela visit long sampela kantri olsem wanpela turis o go long mekim wok bisnis, taim yu go olsem wanpela intanesinel sumating em yu bai stap longpela taim moa long sapos yu go olsem wanpela turis nating.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Planti taim, pasin bilong stap long wanpela narapela kantri long longpela taim em yu bai nid long kisim wanpela visa pastaim.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Ol visa bilong ol sumatin i gat kainkain rikwaimen na rot bilong mekim aplikesen na em i no wankain olsem ol nomol turis o bisnis visa.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Long planti kantri, yu bai nid long i gat wanpela leta i kam long dispela institusen we yu bai stadi long en, na tu yu bai nidim evidens bilong mani yu gat lontg en long sapotim yu yet long wanpela yia bilong kos bilong yu.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Sekim wantaim dispela institusen, na tu sekim 'immigration department' bilong kantri yu laik stadi long en long kisim moa infomesen long ol rikwaimen.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Tasol sapos yu wanpela 'diplomat', pasin bilong wok long narapela kantri em i min olsem yu bai nid long givim 'income tax' long kantri yu stap long en.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Straksa bilong 'income tax' em i narakain long narapela narapela kantri, na reit (rate) bilong takis na 'brackets' em i narakain narakain long wanwan kantri.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Long sampela 'federal' kantri, kain olsem United States na Canada, 'income tax' em i 'federal' level na lokel level wantaim i save kisim, olsem na ol reit (rate) na 'bracket' i ken senis long wanpela rijen i go long narapela.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Maski 'immigration check' em i no save stap o i no save kamap taim yu kam bek long kantri bilong yu, 'customs control' em i ken hat wok liklik.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Yu mas lukim olsem yu save long wanem samting yu ken o i no inap long bringim i go insait long kantri na tokaut sapos mak bilong samting yu bringim em i go antap moa long wanem lo i tok orait long en.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Isipela we bilong statim bisnis bilong 'travel writing' em long stretim pasin bilong yu long rait taim yu statim wanpela 'travel blog' websait.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Taim yu kamap gutpela long mekim 'formatting' na 'editing' long web, orait bihain, yu ken kamapim websait bilong yu yet.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Pasin bilong mekim volentia wok taim yu travel em i wanpela gutpela we long mekim sampela gutpela senis, tasol em i no wansait we yu tasol i givim samting.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Pasin bilong i stap na mekim wok volentia long narapela kantri em i wanpela gutpela we bilong save long narapela kalsa, bungim nupela manmeri, na lainim sampela nupela samting long yu yet, na kisim sampela gutpela tingting na lainim sampela nupela samting.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Em i gutpela we bilong yusim gut bajet (budget) na mekim yu i ken i stpa longpela taim long wanpela hap bikos planti ol wok volentia i save givim rum na kaikai na wanpela liklik pe.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Ol Viking i yusim ol wara bilong Russia long go bek long Black Sea na Caspian Sea. Ol hap bilong ol dispela rot bilong travel long wara em ol lain i ken yusim yet. Sekim sapos i gat nid long kisim spesol tok orait, dispela em i hat long kisim.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: White Sea–Baltic Canal i konektim Arctic Ocean i go long Baltic Sea, long Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, bikpela moa em ol wara na raunwara i konektim.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lake Onega i konekt tu i go long Volga, olsem na long kam olsem long Caspian Sea insait long Russia em i isi long mekim.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Yu mas save olsem taim yu go long ol 'marina' olgeta samting bai kamap ples klia. Yu bai bungim ol narapela lain i save kalap long bot na ol bai serim infomesen wantaim yu.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Yu bai putim ol tok save long helpim yu laik givim, wokabaut i go i kam long ol 'dock', go toktok long lain na klinim ol 'yatch' bilong ol, traim long toktok wantaim ol 'sailor' long ol 'bar, na kain olsem.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Traim long toktok long planti manmeri we yu inap long toktok long en. Bihain long sampela taim olgeta lain bai save long yu na bai givim sampela tok save long yu long wanem ol bot i wok long painim wokman.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Yu mas makim Frequent Flyer 'airline' bilong yu gut.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Maski yu ting olsem em i isi long joinim 'airline' we yu save flai planti taim long en, yu mas save olsem ol samting we ol i save givim em i narakain narakain na ol 'frequent flyer points' we ol i save givim aninit long narapela 'airline' em i gutpela moa long wankain 'alliance'.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Ol 'airline' kain olsem Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines i mekim sevis bilong ol i go long Africa, na ol i givim ol koneksen i go long planti bikpela siti bilong Africa long gutpela prais moa long ol 'airlines' bilong Europe.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines i save flai i go long 39-pela ples insait long 30 kantri insait long Africa stat long 2014 i kam inap nau.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Sapos yu gat sampela moa taim bilong travel, sekim hamas totol bilong raun i go long Africa na hamas totol bilong raun long olgeta hap bilong graun.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No ken lus tingting long putim narapela kost bilong ol narapela visa, 'departure taxes', trenspot, na kain olsem long olgeta ol ples autsait long Africa.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Sapos yu laik flai raun long wol long Southern Hemisphere, namba bilong ol balus i save flai na ol ples bilong i go long en em i no planti bikos i no gat ol 'transoceanic routes'.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: No gat 'airline alliance' i karamapim olgeta tripela 'oceanic crossing' insait long Southern Hemisphere (na SkyTeam i no karampaim wanpela bilong ol dispela 'crossing').
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Tasol, Star Alliance i save karamapim olgeta samting, wanpela samting tasol em i no karamapim em 'eastern' South Pacific long Santiago de Chile i go long Tahiti, dispela em i wanpela LATAM Oneworld flight.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Dispela 'flight' em i no wanpela tasol sapos yu laik lusim South Pacific na 'west coast' bilong South America. (lukim infomesen i stap daunbilo)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Long 1994, ol Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh rijen bilong Azerbaijan i statim woa agensim ol Azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Armenia i sanap baksait long ol, na ol i kamap wantaim nupela 'republic'. Tasol, ol i no kamap olsem wanpela kantri ‑ Armenia tu ‑ i no luksave long ol olsem ol i wanpela kantri.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Ol tok pait long dispela rijen i kontinu long bagarapim ol rilesensip namel long Armenia na Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) em wanpela '17 centruy' distrik we planti lain i save long en na em i raunim Binnenstad long Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Olgeta hap bilong dispela distrik em ol i bin makim olsem wanpela UNESCO World Heritage Site bikos long narakain histori na kalsa bilong em, na kost bilong ol propeti bilong en em i wanpela bilong ol propeti we i bikpela mani tru long em.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, dispela em i min olsem Five Lands, em o gat faivpela liklik ples we i stap klostu long solwara na nem bilong ol em Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso we i stap long Liguria rijen bilong Italy.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Ol i stap long list bilong UNESCO World Heritage.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Long planti 'century' i go pinis, ol manmeri i bin bildim ol fletpela eria long ol ples we i no stret, ol ples we i sanap i go antap i go long 'cliff' we i lukluk i go long solwara.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Wanpela hap bilong samting we i naispela long en em i olsem em i no gat divelopmen long sait bilong bisnis, Ol liklik rot, trein (train) na bot i konketim ol liklik ples, na ol kar i no inap stap long autsait na i go long ol.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Ol 'variety' bilong French we ol i yusim long Belgium na Switzerland i narakain liklik long French we ol yusim long France, maski ol i wankain inap na ol lain long wanpela i ken harim ol lain long narapela 'variety' i toktok.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Bikpela moa, sistem bilong namba insait long Belgium na Switerland we i save yusim French em i narakain long French we ol i yusim long France, na we ol i kolik sampela wod em i narakain liklik.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Maski long dispela, olgeta lain long Belgium na Switzerland we i save yusim French i save lainim 'standard French' insait long skul, olsem na ol bai i inap long save maski yu yusim namba sistem bilong 'standard French'.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Long planti hap bilong graun, pasin bilong 'wave' em i gutpela pasin, we i min olsem "halo."
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Tasol, long Malaysia, long ol Malay i stap long ol longwe ples, em i min olsem "kam hia," wankain olsem 'index finger' yu bendim i kam long bodi bilong yu, wanpela eksen we ol i save yusim long sampela Western kantri, na ol i save yusim long makim dispela tingting.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Wankain tu, wanpela travela (traveller) bilong Briatin long Spain i ken mistek (mistake) na ting olsem em i wanpela 'wave' bilong gutbai we 'palm' bilong han em bai lukluk i kam bek long man i 'wave' (na i no lukluk i go long man we em i 'wave' long en) dispela em i min olsem yu mas kam bek.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Ol 'auxiliary' tok ples em ol 'artificial' o 'constructed' tok ples we ol lain i kamapim bikos ol i lain mekim komunikesen i kamap namel long ol manmeri we i no inap long komuniket.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Ol i stap seperet (seperate) long ol 'lingua franca', dispela em ol 'natural' o 'organic' tok ples we planti lain i yusim bikos long sampela as kain olsem rot bilong toktok namel long ol lain i gat narapela narapela tok ples.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Long hot bilong de, ol travela (traveller) i ken lukim ol 'mirages' we i luk olsem wara (o ol narapela samting).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Dispela i ken kamapim birua, sapos travela (traveller) i bihainim ol dispela 'mirage', em bai westim eneji bilong em na ol wara we em i gat.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Ol hotpela deset (desert) tru i ken kamap kol nogut tru long nait. 'Hypothermia' i ken kamap sapos ol lain i no gat kol klos.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Long sama (summer), yu bai nid long lukaut long ol natnat sapos yu tingting long wokabaut i go insait long renfores (rainforest).
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Maski sapos yu draiv i go insait long wanpela 'subtropical rainforest', liklik taim we yu opim dua long go insait long kar dispela em i inap taim long ol natnat long go insait long kar wantaim yu.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: 'Bird flu', o medikel nem bilong en em 'avian influenza', i ken kamap long ol pisin na ol 'mammal' wantaim.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Planti tausen 'case' ol i bin ripot olsem em i kamap long ol manmeri, tasol sampela bilong ol i bin kamapim bikpela bagarap.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Planti bilong ol i kamap long ol manmeri i wok wantaim kakaruk, tasol dispela sik i ken kamap long ol 'birdwatcher' too.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Wanpela samting we i stap long Norway em ol 'steep fjord' na veli we i save go bungim ol ples antap, o wanpela 'plateau'.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Ol ‘plateau’ em ol i save kolim "‘vidde’" na em i min olsem bikpela, open spes we i no gat diwai, no gat samting i pasim dispela spes.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Insait long Rogaland na Agdar ol i save kolim "‘hei’" na em i min olsem wanpela gras ples we i no gat diwai na ‘heather’ i save karamapim.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Ol ‘glacier’ i no save stap wankain tasol, tasol ol i save ron i kam daun long maunten. Dispela bai kamapim ol ‘crack’, ol hol, we ol sno bris i ken karamapim.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Ol wol na ruf bilong ol ‘ice cave’ i ken pundaun na i ken pasim ol ‘crack’.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Long arere bilong ol ‘glacier’ ol bikpela blok ais i save bruk na lus, pundaun i kam daun na kalap o rol i go longwe moa long dispela hap.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Long taim bilong turis long i go raun long ol stesin i stap long maunten i save kamap long bikpela mak tru long sama (summer) taim bilong India.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Tasol, ol i gat narapela narapela samting i nais na pulim tingting long taim bilong winta (winter), i gat planti stesin i stap antap long maunten i kisim gutpela sno na givim sampela ektiviti kain olsem ‘skiing’ na ‘snowboarding’.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Sampela ol ‘airline’ i save givim yet ol prais bilong go long funerel (funeral), dispela em i liklik diskaun (discount) long kost bilong ol las minit travel.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Ol ‘airline’ i save givim ol dispela dikaun (discount) em include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa long ol ‘flight’ i kam long U.S o Canada, na WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Long olgeta taim, yu mas mekim 'booking' long fon i go stret long 'airline'.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
